title: Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models
summary: General-purpose physical AI models must combine broad visual and linguistic capabilities with precise control across robot embodiments and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. We introduce Rho, a family of open-weights VLA models for bimanual manipulation designed for data-light task adaptation on 3 embodiments representative of dual-arm robots across research labs and the industry -- YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, and FR3 Duo. We systematically ablate Rho's action-expert architecture and training recipe, and show in controlled simulation and physical-robot experiments that embodiment midtraining improves downstream adaptation. The resulting Rho variants for YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, and FR3 Duo match or outperform existing open-weights VLAs and achieve the strongest overall performance across the tasks, embodiments, and baselines evaluated in this report. We further demonstrate the Rho model family's built-in capacity for online adaptation: an internal latent policy learns from corrective feedback to select observation-conditioned noise inputs for the frozen flow-matching action expert. With as few as 15 corrected episodes, adapting this lightweight module enables Rho to handle task situations at the fringe of its offline finetuning distribution. Together, these results position Rho as both a strong general-purpose robotic manipulation model and a practical foundation for adaptation. We release the base Rho model and the embodiment-specific checkpoints to facilitate Rho's deployment in research experiments and practical industrial use cases.
tldr: Rho introduces a family of open-weights VLA models for bimanual manipulation, systematically ablating an action-expert architecture and demonstrating that embodiment midtraining improves downstream adaptation across three dual-arm robot embodiments, with a lightweight internal latent policy enabling few-shot online correction adaptation.
tldr_zh: Rho提出了一系列用于双臂操作的开源VLA模型，系统消融了动作专家架构，并证明在三个双臂机器人平台上进行具身中期训练能提升下游适应能力，同时通过轻量级内部潜变量策略实现少量纠正样本的在线适应。
summary_zh: 通用型物理AI模型必须将广泛的视觉和语言能力与跨机器人本体的精确控制以及对下游任务的高效适应能力相结合。我们推出Rho，一个面向双臂操作的开源权重VLA模型家族，专为在三种代表研究实验室和工业界双臂机器人的本体——YAM Box、UR AI Trainer和FR3 Duo——上进行轻量数据任务适应而设计。我们系统地消融了Rho的动作专家架构和训练方案，并在受控仿真和物理机器人实验中证明，本体中期训练能改善下游适应性能。由此产生的针对YAM Box、UR AI Trainer和FR3 Duo的Rho变体在性能上匹配或超越了现有开源权重VLA模型，并在本报告评估的任务、本体和基线中取得了最强的整体表现。我们进一步展示了Rho模型家族内置的在线适应能力：一个内部潜在策略从纠正性反馈中学习，为冻结的流匹配动作专家选择基于观测条件的噪声输入。仅需少至15次纠正回合，适应这一轻量模块即可使Rho处理其离线微调分布边缘的任务情境。综合来看，这些结果使Rho既成为一个强大的通用机器人操作模型，也成为实用的适应基础。我们发布了基础Rho模型及针对特定本体的检查点，以促进Rho在研究实验和实际工业应用中的部署。

title: EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification
summary: Improving robot policies on new tasks without collecting additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge in robot learning. World action models (WAMs) use broad video priors to jointly predict future videos and actions, offering a potential source of supervision for adapting to new tasks. However, generated videos may fail to depict task completion, and even visually successful videos may be paired with inconsistent actions that lead to execution failure. We propose EVO-WAM, a framework that adapts WAMs to unseen tasks by learning from their own generated video-action trajectories, without executing candidate actions in an external environment. First, we augment WAM training with state prediction and anchored multi-frame context to enable complete autoregressive rollouts without external execution feedback. Second, we identify reliable training experience by selecting task-completing prefixes with a vision-language model and verifying their video-action consistency with an inverse dynamics model. Third, we iteratively train the WAM on verified prefixes and generate new rollouts with the updated model. On seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, EVO-WAM increases average success rates from 26.9% to 68.0% for Cosmos3 and from 28.5% to 46.4% for DreamZero, reaching approximately $2.5\times$ and $1.6\times$ their initial success rates. On three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world, it improves Cosmos3's average success rate from 20.0% to 76.7%, a gain of 56.7 percentage points. Project Page: https://evo-wam.github.io/.
tldr: EVO-WAM adapts world action models to unseen robot tasks without external demonstrations or execution, using state prediction, anchored context, and VLM-based verification of generated video-action trajectories, significantly improving success rates in simulation and the real world.
tldr_zh: EVO-WAM 通过状态预测、锚定上下文和基于VLM的验证，利用世界动作模型自身生成的视频-动作轨迹进行迭代训练，无需额外演示或外部执行即可适应新任务，显著提升模拟和真实世界的成功率。
summary_zh: 改进机器人策略以完成新任务，而无需收集额外的专家示范，仍是机器人学习中的核心挑战。世界动作模型（WAMs）利用广泛的视频先验知识，联合预测未来视频和动作，为适应新任务提供了一种潜在的监督来源。然而，生成的视频可能无法准确反映任务完成情况，即使视觉上成功的视频也可能与不一致的动作配对，从而导致执行失败。我们提出了EVO-WAM框架，该框架通过从模型自身生成的视频-动作轨迹中学习，适应未见任务，而无需在外部环境中执行候选动作。首先，我们通过引入状态预测和锚定多帧上下文来增强WAM训练，使其能够在没有外部执行反馈的情况下进行完整的自回归展开。其次，我们通过使用视觉语言模型选择完成任务的前缀，并利用逆动力学模型验证其视频-动作一致性，来识别可靠的训练经验。第三，我们迭代地在经过验证的前缀上训练WAM，并使用更新后的模型生成新的展开轨迹。在七个未见过的RoboTwin 2.0任务中，EVO-WAM将Cosmos3的平均成功率从26.9%提升至68.0%，将DreamZero的平均成功率从28.5%提升至46.4%，分别达到其初始成功率的约2.5倍和1.6倍。在真实世界的三个未见过的长时程复合任务中，它使Cosmos3的平均成功率从20.0%提升至76.7%，提升了56.7个百分点。项目页面：https://evo-wam.github.io/。

title: EgoAlign: Bridging the Human-Humanoid Gap for Long-Range Loco-Manipulation
summary: Egocentric human demonstrations offer an accessible source of task experience, but differences in body scale and controller response, together with missing robot states, limit their value as humanoid training supervision. We present EgoAlign, a data-construction framework that converts these demonstrations into action and state supervision compatible with a general-purpose, continuous whole-body controller, without collecting physical-robot demonstrations. Using the target-robot model and simulator, EgoAlign guides demonstration collection through execution feedback. It preserves locomotion references for visually guided periodic stepping while adapting upper-body interaction geometry through scale alignment and controller-in-the-loop refinement. A final causal replay reconstructs the corresponding robot states and motion-token labels for training with the human observations. We assess the resulting supervision by fine-tuning a vision--language--action model solely on adapted human demonstrations and deploying it zero-shot on a physical humanoid. The resulting policies perform long-range object relocation, navigation to unseen goal positions, and independently evaluated foot interaction. Refinement improves simulated hand alignment and physical pickup success over kinematic alignment alone, while human collection reduces on-site acquisition time relative to teleoperation. https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/EgoAlign/
tldr: EgoAlign converts egocentric human demonstrations into action and state supervision for humanoid robots using a target-robot simulator and controller-in-the-loop refinement, enabling zero-shot deployment of a VLA policy for long-range loco-manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: EgoAlign 利用目标机器人模拟器和控制器在环优化，将以自我为中心的人类演示转换为适用于人形机器人的动作和状态监督，使得 VLA 策略能够零样本部署于长距离移动操作任务。
summary_zh: 自我中心的人类演示为任务经验提供了易获取的来源，但身体尺度与控制响应的差异，以及机器人状态的缺失，限制了其作为人形机器人训练监督信号的效用。我们提出EgoAlign，一种数据构建框架，将此类演示转化为与通用连续全身控制器兼容的动作与状态监督信号，而无需采集实体机器人演示。借助目标机器人模型与仿真器，EgoAlign通过执行反馈引导演示采集。在保留视觉引导周期步态的 locomotion 参考的同时，通过尺度对齐与控制器在环精修，自适应调整上半身交互几何结构。最终的因果回放重建对应的机器人状态与运动令牌标签，用于结合人类观测进行训练。我们通过仅基于自适应后的人类演示微调视觉-语言-动作模型，并将其零样本部署于实体人形机器人，以评估所生成的监督信号。所得策略可执行长距离物体搬运、导航至未见目标位置，以及独立评估的足部交互。与仅采用运动学对齐相比，精修提升了仿真中的手部对齐精度与实体拾取成功率，同时人类采集相较于遥操作减少了现场采集时间。https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/EgoAlign/

title: PhysWAM: Physically Consistent World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions. We present PhysWAM, a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer. To ground world and action generation in measured scene geometry, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP) that unprojects the generated depth into 3D points, transforms them using the generated $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ ego motion, and minimizes their distance to LiDAR points transformed using the recorded ego motion. This geometric constraint promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by jointly supervising generated depth and motion alongside their standard flow-matching objectives. At inference, trajectory selection relies only on a simple label-free consensus rule, with no learned scorer or simulator feedback. We evaluate PhysWAM across NAVSIM v1 and v2 planning, zero-shot closed-loop transfer, and future video and metric-depth prediction. Despite PhysWAM's simple selection procedure, it achieves strong planning performance and transfers zero-shot to unseen driving environments. It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video, with CPP improving both planning and depth prediction. Together, these results demonstrate that the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion provides a direct way to couple world and action generation within a simple unified model.
tldr: PhysWAM is a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer, using a Coupled Point Projection (CPP) geometric constraint to ensure physical consistency between generated depth and ego motion. It achieves strong planning performance and zero-shot transfer to unseen environments without learned scorers or simulator feedback.
tldr_zh: PhysWAM是一个用于自动驾驶的统一世界动作模型，在单个流匹配Transformer中共同去噪多视角视频、度量深度和自车运动，利用耦合点投影（CPP）几何约束确保生成深度与自车运动之间的物理一致性。在没有学习评分器或模拟器反馈的情况下，它实现了强大的规划性能和零样本迁移。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）联合预测场景如何演变以及智能体应如何行动，然而仅靠联合生成并不必然在这些预测之间施加共享的几何约束。我们提出PhysWAM，一种用于自动驾驶的统一世界-动作模型，在单一流匹配Transformer中对多视角视频、度量深度和自车运动进行协同去噪。为了将世界生成和动作生成锚定在实测场景几何中，我们引入了耦合点投影（CPP），该方法将生成的深度反投影为三维点，利用生成的自车运动$\mathrm{SE}(3)$对这些点进行变换，并最小化其与利用记录的自车运动变换后的LiDAR点之间的距离。这一几何约束通过将生成的深度和运动与其标准流匹配目标联合监督，促进与实测场景的物理一致性。在推理阶段，轨迹选择仅依赖简单的无标签共识规则，无需学习评分器或模拟器反馈。我们在NAVSIM v1和v2规划、零样本闭环迁移以及未来视频和度量深度预测中评估PhysWAM。尽管PhysWAM选择流程简单，它仍取得了优异的规划性能，并零样本迁移至未见过的驾驶环境。它还生成准确的度量深度和时间连贯的视频，其中CPP同时改善了规划和深度预测。综合来看，这些结果表明场景深度与自车运动之间的几何关系为在简单统一模型中耦合世界生成和动作生成提供了一条直接途径。

title: Learning Expressive and Compositional Motion Representation via Spectral Skills
summary: Robotic foundation models offer a promising path toward general-purpose humanoid robot control, often through hierarchical architectures. However, their effectiveness depends on the command interface between the planner and the controller, which must support accurate execution while remaining easy to predict, and ideally allow new behaviors to be composed from prior ones. In this work, we introduce spectral skills, a latent representation of this interface that meets these requirements through predictive representation learning. By design, spectral skills compactly encode short motion segments and are learned by predicting subsequent motion rather than reconstructing the encoder input. On a 29-DoF humanoid, a controller conditioned on spectral skills reduces global tracking error by 62\% relative to the state of the art. The same frozen controller chains independently encoded skills without a separate transition policy. It also composes new behaviors by adding orthogonal directions to any compatible base skill, producing combinations unseen in the training data. We demonstrate tracking, chaining, and composition, as well as control through a language-conditioned planner, on Unitree G1 hardware. Project page: https://spectral-skill.github.io
tldr: This paper introduces spectral skills, a latent motion representation for humanoid control, learned via predictive representation learning, which enables accurate tracking, skill chaining, and composition of new behaviors, demonstrated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了频谱技能，一种通过预测性表征学习获得的人形机器人运动潜表征，可实现精确跟踪、技能链接以及新行为组合，并在真实Unitree G1人形机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 基础模型为实现通用人形机器人控制提供了一条有前景的路径，其通常采用分层架构。然而，其有效性取决于规划器与控制器之间的指令接口，该接口既要支持精确执行，又要易于预测，并且理想情况下能够从已有行为中组合出新的行为。在本研究中，我们引入了频谱技能，这是一种通过预测性表征学习满足上述要求的接口潜在表示。在设计上，频谱技能对短时运动片段进行紧凑编码，并通过预测后续运动而非重建编码器输入来学习。在一个29自由度的人形机器人上，以频谱技能为条件的控制器将全局跟踪误差相较现有最先进方法降低了62%。同一冻结控制器能够链接独立编码的技能，而无需单独的过渡策略。此外，它还能通过在任意兼容基础技能上添加正交方向来组合出新行为，产生训练数据中未曾出现的组合。我们在宇树G1硬件上演示了跟踪、链接与组合，以及通过语言条件规划器进行的控制。项目页面：https://spectral-skill.github.io

title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
summary: Video-based policy learning is particularly promising, as it illustrates target behaviors without requiring action annotations or embodiment-matched demonstrations. A central challenge is deciding what information should be transferred from the video to the robot. Existing approaches commonly convert visual observations into scalar similarity or value signals, or ask foundation models to directly generate reward code. These approaches can make the temporal structure of a task difficult to inspect, ground, and reuse. We present Video2STL, a framework that converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and uses the resulting formal representation for robot learning. A vision-language model extracts an embodiment-independent semantic event trace and constructs a bank of symbolic temporal specifications. The model determines the task structure, while numerical predicate thresholds and temporal bounds are grounded from successful robot trajectories. For policy learning, we separate short- and long-timescale temporal information: short-horizon specifications provide dense rewards through rolling-window quantitative robustness, while a causal monitor over a retained long-horizon specification provides one-time progress rewards for valid temporal prefixes. The same representation supports cross-embodiment transfer from human or animal videos to robot control. Across four manipulation tasks, Video2STL achieves $85.8\%$ average success-once and $67.0\%$ success-at-end, compared with $81.5\%/59.5\%$ for native dense PPO and $65.0\%/42.3\%$ for Text2Reward; in quadruped locomotion, Qwen-3.8 and GPT-5.6-based Video2STL policies achieve $100\%$ success across velocities from $0.3$ to $2.1\,\mathrm{m/s}$ while remaining competitive in high-speed energy efficiency. Project webpage: \href{https://video2stl.github.io/}{video2stl}.
tldr: Video2STL converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications using a vision-language model and grounds them with robot trajectories, providing interpretable dense rewards for robot policy learning and enabling cross-embodiment transfer.
tldr_zh: Video2STL利用视觉语言模型将仅包含观测的视频转换为参数化信号时态逻辑（STL）规范，并通过机器人轨迹进行落地，为机器人策略学习提供可解释的稠密奖励，支持跨形态迁移。
summary_zh: 基于视频的策略学习尤其具有前景，因为它能够在不依赖动作标注或与体态匹配的演示的情况下展示目标行为。其中一个核心挑战在于决定应从视频中向机器人传递哪些信息。现有方法通常将视觉观察转化为标量相似度或价值信号，或要求基础模型直接生成奖励代码。这些方法可能使得任务的时间结构难以检查、落地和重用。我们提出了Video2STL框架，该框架将仅含观测的视频转化为参数化的信号时序逻辑（STL）规格，并利用所得的形式化表示进行机器人学习。视觉-语言模型提取与体态无关的语义事件轨迹，并构建符号时序规格库。该模型确定任务结构，而数值谓词阈值和时间边界则从成功的机器人轨迹中落地确定。在策略学习方面，我们将短时间尺度与长时间尺度的时序信息分离：短时域规格通过滚动窗口的定量鲁棒性提供密集奖励，而对保留的长时间尺度规格的因果监测器则为有效时间前缀提供一次性进展奖励。同一表示支持从人类或动物视频到机器人控制的跨体态迁移。在四个操作任务中，Video2STL实现了平均$85.8\%$的一次成功率（success-once）和$67.0\%$的最终成功率（success-at-end），相比之下，原生密集PPO为$81.5\%/59.5\%$，Text2Reward为$65.0\%/42.3\%$；在四足运动任务中，基于Qwen-3.8和GPT-5.6的Video2STL策略在速度从$0.3$到$2.1\,\mathrm{m/s}$范围内实现了$100\%$的成功率，同时在高速度能量效率方面保持竞争力。项目网页：\href{https://video2stl.github.io/}{video2stl}。

title: Remember What You Did: Action-History Memory with Dual-Expert Denoising for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have driven rapid progress in robotic manipulation, demonstrating strong fine-grained control and promising performance on long-horizon tasks. However, many existing VLAs lack explicit access to interaction history, making them vulnerable to perceptual aliasing: similar current observations and robot states at different task stages may induce action ambiguity and lower success rate. Existing methods incorporate temporal or progress cues through feature conditioning, action-prior modification, or sampling guidance. However, methods that jointly fine-tune memory modules and the base VLA incur additional policy-training costs, motivating the separation of trainable history-conditioned steering from frozen base-policy refinement. We propose ActMem-VLA, a dual-expert handover architecture that augments a frozen, fine-tuned VLA with a memory plugin comprising a Mamba-based memory module and a lightweight PreAction Expert (PAE). Specifically, Mamba encodes executed-action history into memory that conditions PAE alongside current context. With these inputs, PAE steers task progression during early, high-noise denoising, then passes the partially denoised action to the frozen Action Expert (AE) to refine action details during the remaining low-noise steps. The fine-tuned base VLA remains frozen throughout training, while only the Mamba module and PAE are jointly optimized. On LIBERO-Mem, ActMem-VLA achieves 80.8\% average success across all ten tasks, compared with 65.2\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 49.5\% for MemoryVLA, while introducing only 3.45\% additional parameters. Across four real-world tasks, it improves the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ by 28.8\%.
tldr: ActMem-VLA proposes a dual-expert denoising architecture that adds a Mamba-based memory module and a lightweight PreAction Expert to a frozen VLA policy, using executed-action history to disambiguate long-horizon manipulation tasks. It achieves state-of-the-art success on LIBERO-Mem and real-world tasks with minimal added parameters.
tldr_zh: ActMem-VLA提出了一种双专家去噪架构，在冻结的VLA策略上增加基于Mamba的记忆模块和轻量级预动作专家，利用历史动作序列来解决长期操作任务中的感知混淆问题。在LIBERO-Mem和真实世界任务上取得了领先成功率，且仅增加极少量参数。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作领域的快速发展，展示了强大的细粒度控制能力，并在长时程任务中表现出 promising 的性能。然而，许多现有VLA模型缺乏对交互历史的显式访问，因而容易受到感知混叠问题的影响：不同任务阶段中相似的当前观测和机器人状态可能引发动作歧义，从而降低任务成功率。已有方法通过特征条件化、动作先验修正或采样引导来纳入时间或进度线索，但联合微调记忆模块与基础VLA的方法会增加额外的策略训练成本，因此有必要将可训练的历史条件引导与冻结的基础策略优化相分离。我们提出了ActMem-VLA，一种双专家交接架构，通过记忆插件增强冻结的、已微调的VLA模型，该插件包含基于Mamba的记忆模块和轻量级预动作专家（PAE）。具体而言，Mamba将已执行动作的历史编码为记忆，并结合当前上下文条件化PAE。基于这些输入，PAE在早期高噪声去噪阶段引导任务推进，随后将部分去噪后的动作交接给冻结的动作专家（AE），由其在剩余低噪声阶段细化动作细节。在训练过程中，已微调的基础VLA始终保持冻结，仅对Mamba模块和PAE进行联合优化。在LIBERO-Mem基准上，ActMem-VLA在所有十个任务上的平均成功率达到80.8%，而$π_{0.5}$为65.2%，MemoryVLA为49.5%，且仅引入了3.45%的额外参数量。在四个真实世界任务中，相较于$π_{0.5}$，其平均成功率提升了28.8%。

title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.
tldr: EgoHumanoid-V2 presents a framework for transferring coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation skills from egocentric human demonstrations to humanoid robots, using coarse-to-fine action alignment and visual augmentation to achieve zero-shot skill transfer with VLA policies, achieving performance comparable to teleoperation-trained policies.
tldr_zh: EgoHumanoid-V2 提出了一种框架，用于将协调的全身移动操作技能从以自我为中心的人类演示迁移到仿人机器人，通过从粗到细的动作对齐和视觉增强，使 VLA 策略实现零样本技能迁移，其性能可与基于遥操作数据训练的策略相媲美。
summary_zh: 人类演示捕捉了多样化的场景和丰富的全身技能，无需机器人遥操作即可实现。以往关于第一人称视角迁移的研究主要强调解耦控制下运动操控的场景泛化，而对协调全身技能的直接迁移探索较少。我们提出了EgoHumanoid-V2，这是首个基于第一人称视角的人到人形机器人技能迁移框架，用于协调全身运动操控。其核心在于粗到细的动作对齐，结合了运动学参考校正与动力学感知优化，在保持全身协调的同时提升末端执行器位姿精度。我们还采用机械臂渲染和训练时图像增强来缩小视觉具身差异，并增强视角鲁棒性。在四个真实世界任务中，基于对齐人类数据训练的语言-视觉-动作（VLA）策略展现出零样本技能迁移能力，无需目标任务机器人演示。任务得分与基于遥操作数据训练的策略相当，而数据采集成本更低。这些结果支持将人类数据作为直接技能监督来源。

title: CoRe-VLA: Preserving Cross-View Coordination in VLAs under Camera Shifts
summary: VLAs combine pretrained vision-language representations with action generation to enable language-guided control across diverse tasks, becoming a mainstream paradigm in embodied intelligence. However, multiple studies have reported VLA's substantial declines in task success under camera shifts, revealing a key vulnerability that limits reliable deployment. To address this vulnerability, existing methods collect paired observations of the same scene from different viewpoints to fine-tune the VLA or train visual adaptation modules. Unfortunately, they require additional data collection and VLA training costs. In this paper, we first identify \emph{cross-view coordination breakdown} under external camera shifts: the robot may rely too heavily on wrist-view cues and consequently execute subtasks in the wrong order when losing global view. Motivated by this, we propose CoRe-VLA, a plug-and-play framework requiring neither additional multi-view data collection nor VLA fine-tuning, which can incorporate with exsiting VLAs. It reconstructs a scene point cloud and renders the observation from the VLA's training viewpoint to restore cross-view coordination. In CoRe-VLA, Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration reduces rendering-induced visual degradation, while Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA) reduces robot idle time and mitigates motion conflicts during asynchronous execution. Experiments on 5 real-robot tasks, LIBERO-100 and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate CoRe-VLA substantially improves task success across mainstream VLAs under camera shifts. For example, CoRe-VLA raises PI0.5's success rate from 13.3% to 83.3% at a 1.6m camera shift in real-robot environment.
tldr: CoRe-VLA is a plug-and-play framework that preserves cross-view coordination in Vision-Language-Action models under camera shifts by reconstructing a scene point cloud and rendering observations from the training viewpoint, improving task success without additional data collection or fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: CoRe-VLA 是一个即插即用的框架，通过重建场景点云并从训练视角渲染观测，在相机移位下保持视觉-语言-动作模型中的跨视角协调，无需额外数据收集或微调即可提高任务成功率。
summary_zh: VLAs将预训练的视觉-语言表示与动作生成相结合，使语言引导的控制能够跨越多种任务，成为具身智能领域的主流范式。然而，多项研究报道VLA在相机移位下任务成功率显著下降，揭示了限制其可靠部署的一个关键脆弱性。针对这一脆弱性，现有方法通过收集同一场景在不同视角下的成对观测来微调VLA或训练视觉适应模块。然而，这些方法需要额外的数据收集和VLA训练成本。本文首先识别出外部相机移位下的“跨视角协调崩溃”问题：当失去全局视角时，机器人可能过度依赖腕部视角线索，从而以错误的顺序执行子任务。为此，我们提出了CoRe-VLA，这是一个即插即用的框架，既不需要额外的多视角数据收集，也不需要VLA微调，可与现有VLA集成。它重建场景点云，并从VLA训练视角渲染观测，以恢复跨视角协调。在CoRe-VLA中，渲染到相机（R2C）恢复机制减少了渲染引起的视觉退化，而执行轨迹条件对齐（ETCA）减少了机器人在异步执行过程中的空闲时间，并缓解了运动冲突。在5项真实机器人任务、LIBERO-100和LIBERO-Plus上的实验表明，CoRe-VLA在相机移位下显著提高了主流VLA的任务成功率。例如，在真实机器人环境中1.6米相机移位下，CoRe-VLA将PI0.5的成功率从13.3%提升至83.3%。

title: V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.
tldr: V2X-WAM proposes a cooperative world action model for end-to-end autonomous driving that integrates vehicle-infrastructure perception with multimodal trajectory planning and future-world reasoning, improving planning accuracy and safety.
tldr_zh: V2X-WAM提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的协同世界动作模型，将车路协同感知与多模态轨迹规划和未来世界推理相结合，提高了规划准确性和安全性。
summary_zh: 车路协同能够通过更广泛、更丰富的交通环境观测来补充车载感知，为端到端自动驾驶提供有力支持。然而，现有的协同驾驶方法主要利用路侧信息来增强当前场景的表征，很少显式建模未来驾驶行为可能带来的后果。这限制了规划器预测其决策如何与动态演化的交通环境交互的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了V2X-WAM，一种协同世界动作模型，该模型将协同场景理解、动作生成和未来世界推理紧密结合。V2X-WAM从车辆端和路侧端观测中构建可靠性感知的时空表征，同时将路侧信息压缩为紧凑的量化消息以实现高效通信。基于所得的协同表征，多模态规划器生成前瞻性轨迹，并显式地以该轨迹为条件预测未来占用和动态流量。预测得到的世界后果随后被反馈用于优化规划轨迹，形成动作与未来世界演化之间的闭环交互。在大规模真实世界协同驾驶数据集上的实验表明，V2X-WAM在规划精度和安全性上持续优于具有代表性的端到端协同驾驶方法，同时在未来世界预测方面表现更强，且通信开销显著更低。消融研究进一步验证了所提设计的有效性。

title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
summary: Current embodied models do not respond to their own failures, although what just went wrong could inform a small adjustment on the next attempt, the kind of reflection behind the gains of thinking in language models. We test whether they can repair a known error, which requires producing a correction and judging whether it is right. Stopped at a failure and allowed to retry, they seldom repair it through their own randomness or from a language description of the error, and best-of-N selection cannot pick the successful candidate after a failure. We attribute this to training only on successful demonstrations and to inputs too narrow to show what went wrong, and conclude that reflection must come from a vision-language model (VLM), which takes in far more information, such as the episode history and text, and is more general. Prior VLM-led work has the VLM plan every step and invoke the embodied model as a tool, placing the VLM on the critical path. We propose Spotter, which reverses the roles: the embodied model leads and executes continuously, while the VLM runs in parallel, monitors through a lightweight local screener, intervenes only when an error is detected, reflects on and corrects it, and returns control. We run Spotter with Qwen and with GPT as the VLM, and both improve the embodied models; with GPT, Spotter improves Cosmos Policy and $π_{0.5}$ by 5.6 and 7.5 percentage points on RoboCasa, and raises $π_{0.5}$ from 47.2% to 57.0% on the Hard setting of RoboTwin 2.0 and from 53% to 83% on a real robot. Because the VLM steps in only when an error is confirmed, a successful episode with Qwen takes only 13 to 16 s longer than with the embodied model alone and about 70% less time than with a VLM-led baseline using the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/zqc3117/Spotter.
tldr: Spotter reverses the typical VLM-led robot control paradigm by having an embodied policy lead continuous execution while a VLM monitors in parallel and only intervenes on detected failures, leading to significant performance gains on RoboCasa, RoboTwin, and a real robot with low latency overhead.
tldr_zh: Spotter 颠覆了常见的 VLM 主导的机器人控制范式，让具身策略主导连续执行，VLM 并行监控并仅在检测到失败时介入纠正，从而在 RoboCasa、RoboTwin 和真实机器人上取得显著性能提升，且延迟开销很低。
summary_zh: 当前具身模型无法对自身的失败做出响应，尽管刚刚出现的错误本可以为下一次尝试提供微小调整的线索，而正是这种反思推动了语言模型在思维层面的进步。我们测试这些模型是否能够修复已知错误，这需要生成修正方案并判断其是否正确。当模型在失败处被暂停并允许重试时，它们很少能通过自身的随机性或者对错误的语言描述来修复问题，而“N中取最优”的选择策略也无法在失败后选出成功的候选方案。我们将此归因于模型仅基于成功的演示进行训练，以及输入信息过于狭窄，无法揭示出问题所在，并得出结论：反思必须由视觉-语言模型（VLM）来承担，因为该模型能够获取更丰富的信息，例如片段历史记录和文本，并且更具泛化能力。此前以VLM为主导的工作让VLM规划每一步，并将具身模型作为工具来调用，使VLM处于关键路径之上。我们提出了Spotter，它颠倒了角色分工：具身模型主导并持续执行，而VLM并行运行，通过轻量级本地筛查器进行监控，仅在检测到错误时介入，对错误进行反思和修正，然后将控制权交还。我们分别使用Qwen和GPT作为VLM运行Spotter，两者均提升了具身模型的性能；使用GPT时，Spotter在RoboCasa上将Cosmos Policy和$π_{0.5}$分别提升了5.6和7.5个百分点，并在RoboTwin 2.0的Hard设置下将$π_{0.5}$从47.2%提高到57.0%，在真实机器人上将从53%提高到83%。由于仅在错误被确认时VLM才会介入，使用Qwen的成功的执行回合比仅使用具身模型仅多耗时13至16秒，比使用相同模型的VLM主导基线缩短约70%的时间。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zqc3117/Spotter 获取。

title: Where Predictive Supervision Goes Shapes What VLA Policies Learn
summary: Future prediction is increasingly used to improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies, based on the premise that anticipating scene evolution encourages representations useful for control. However, forecast quality alone does not establish that a policy has learned a better representation for action. This distinction matters under distribution shift, where successful control depends on preserving spatial state and likely scene change beyond familiar configurations. We study what determines whether predictive supervision improves the visual representation used by a VLA policy. Through controlled comparisons with matched target constructions, prediction horizons, and training conditions, we find that different prediction interfaces produce markedly different forecasts and visual representations, including in the spatial, dynamics, and action information that transfers beyond familiar scenes. We trace these differences to how predictive errors shape the policy's visual stream. Consistent with this controlled finding, VLA policies trained with more direct, scene-matched future supervision show stronger robustness under simulated and physical distribution shifts. Together, our results frame future prediction as a representation-learning design problem whose value for control depends on whether its supervision reaches the representations through which the policy acts.
tldr: This paper studies how different predictive supervision interfaces shape the visual representations learned by vision-language-action (VLA) policies, showing that direct, scene-matched future prediction improves robustness under distribution shift in both simulation and physical robots.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了不同的预测监督接口如何塑造VLA策略学习到的视觉表征，证明了直接、场景匹配的未来预测能在仿真和物理机器人的分布偏移下提升鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 未来预测日益被用于提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，其基本前提是，预期场景演变能够鼓励形成对控制有用的表征。然而，仅凭预测质量并不能证明策略已为动作学习到更好的表征。这一区别在分布偏移情况下尤为重要，此时成功的控制依赖于在熟悉配置之外保持空间状态及可能的场景变化。我们研究了何种因素决定预测监督是否提升VLA策略所使用的视觉表征。通过匹配目标构造、预测视界和训练条件的受控比较，我们发现不同的预测接口会产生显著不同的预测结果和视觉表征，包括在空间、动态及动作信息方面超出熟悉场景的迁移能力。我们将这些差异追溯至预测误差如何塑造策略的视觉流。与这一受控发现一致，使用更直接、场景匹配的未来监督训练的VLA策略在模拟和物理分布偏移下表现出更强的鲁棒性。综上，我们的研究将未来预测框定为表征学习的设计问题，其对控制的价值取决于其监督是否到达策略据以行动的表征。

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
summary: We study reinforcement learning (RL) methods for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This problem is challenging because VLAs are pretrained on large-scale single-agent data and therefore lack the fine-grained coordination skills required for inter-robot collaboration. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-robot demonstrations partially bridges this gap, but its performance is bounded by the demonstration data and cannot improve from its own experience. We present a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline for multi-agent VLAs. First, initialization-aware data collection sweeps over initial configurations and invokes human demonstrations only when the pretrained VLA repeatedly fails, yielding robustness to initialization shift with reduced human cost. Second, offline credit-filtered tuning assigns credit to individual agents and fine-tunes on per-agent trajectories with positive advantage rather than on entire joint rollouts. Third, we find existing online RL for VLAs are less effective for hard multi-agent tasks, which we attribute to noisy co-exploration and unstable updates. We instead use online latent-space fine tuning, which freeze the VLA and perform RL in its latent noise space. We evaluate our multi-agent VLA with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ backbones across 11 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboFactory and real-world manipulation with two Franka robots. Our multi-agent VLA improves the average success rate by $+23.1\%$, $+16.4\%$, and $+44\%$ on RoboTwin, RoboFactory, and real-world tasks, respectively. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mavla_rft-2BC0/.
tldr: This paper introduces a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning pipeline for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action models, improving coordination and success rates across simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对协作式多智能体视觉-语言-动作模型的三阶段强化微调流程，提升了仿真和真实机器人操作任务中的协调能力和成功率。
summary_zh: 我们研究面向协作多智能体视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的强化学习（RL）方法。该问题具有挑战性，因为VLA在大规模单智能体数据上预训练，因此缺乏机器人间协作所需的细粒度协调技能。基于多机器人示范数据的监督微调（SFT）部分弥补了这一差距，但其性能受限于示范数据，无法从自身经验中提升。我们提出了一种面向多智能体VLA的三阶段强化微调（RFT）流程。首先，初始化感知的数据采集覆盖多种初始配置，且仅在预训练VLA反复失败时调用人类示范，从而在降低人力成本的同时增强对初始化偏移的鲁棒性。其次，离线信用过滤微调将信用分配给各个智能体，并基于每个智能体轨迹中具有正优势的部分进行微调，而非对整个联合轨迹进行微调。第三，我们发现现有面向VLA的在线强化学习在处理困难多智能体任务时效果欠佳，这归因于噪声协同探索和不稳定的更新。因此，我们改用在线潜在空间微调，该方法冻结VLA并在其潜在噪声空间中进行强化学习。我们在RoboTwin、RoboFactory中的11项任务以及使用两台Franka机器人的真实世界操控任务中，使用$π_0$和$π_{0.5}$主干网络评估了我们的多智能体VLA。我们的多智能体VLA在RoboTwin、RoboFactory和真实世界任务上的平均成功率分别提升了$+23.1\%$、$+16.4\%$和$+44\%$。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mavla_rft-2BC0/。

title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.
tldr: This paper introduces Staircase Policy, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style world-action model by partitioning action chunks into staggered sub-chunks with re-predicted future latents, enabling faster and more accurate long-horizon robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了阶梯策略，一种流式推理与训练框架，将流匹配VLA转变为JEPA风格的世界-动作模型，通过交错去噪阶段划分动作块并重新预测未来潜在状态，实现更快速、更准确的长期机器人操作。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过基于预测的未来观测来条件化动作生成，从而改进机器人操作，但未来预测在已经昂贵的迭代式动作生成之上进一步增加了推理开销。动作分块可以将这一成本分摊到多个动作上，但在长时间执行范围内，性能会下降，因为后续动作仍基于过时的观测进行条件化。我们提出**阶梯策略**（STAIRCASE POLICY），一种流式推理与训练框架，将流匹配型视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）转化为JEPA风格的世界-动作模型，并将大型动作块在错开的去噪阶段划分为子块。近期动作一旦可用即立即执行，而后续动作则继续被精化。在每个子块边界处，未来潜在表示根据最新观测重新预测，并用于更新所有未执行的动作，从而在不进行重复的完整策略推理的情况下实现长时程执行。由此产生的未来预测误差还可作为自适应分块的信号。S-WAM在LIBERO上达到97.7%，在LIBERO-Plus上达到87.9%，并在多个策略骨干网络和真实机器人任务上提升了性能。其每秒可执行292.7个动作，在相近精度下吞吐量达到传统执行方式的3.62倍，同时将首次动作时间从123.6毫秒缩短至73.3毫秒。结合额外的推理优化，吞吐量进一步提升至每秒642.9个动作。

title: World4Scorer: Outcome-Grounded World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires choosing a safe and efficient plan as surrounding traffic evolves. Generate-and-select planners propose multiple trajectories and score them for execution, and they have outperformed representative direct-prediction baselines on NAVSIM. Their scorer must compare plans that were never executed. Driving logs record the future of only the executed trajectory, so matching the logged future can leave predictions for the alternatives unconstrained; a simulator, in contrast, can label the outcome of every candidate. We introduce World4Scorer, which builds the scorer as a trajectory-conditioned JEPA-style predictor: it predicts a state for each candidate and reads the candidate's scores from that state. Simulator outcome labels supervise the states of all candidates, and the observed future of the executed trajectory anchors the predictor to real scene evolution. Because one predictor produces every candidate's state, the anchor can constrain shared parameters used to score unexecuted plans, while the future itself is needed only during training. Generated candidates mostly score well, so a scene-matched bank adds low-scoring plans to the outcome supervision; framewise choices can conflict, so inertial re-ranking keeps consecutive selections consistent. World4Scorer achieves state-of-the-art NAVSIM-v2 performance and a strong adapted-system result on closed-loop Bench2Drive. With the LeWM world model and planning budget fixed, outcome-based scoring also improves manipulation planning on the OGBench-Cube benchmark.
tldr: World4Scorer introduces a trajectory-conditioned JEPA-style scorer trained with simulator outcome labels for generate-and-select autonomous driving planners, achieving SOTA on NAVSIM-v2 and strong closed-loop Bench2Drive results, also improving manipulation planning on OGBench-Cube.
tldr_zh: World4Scorer 提出了一种基于 JEPA 风格、以模拟器结果标签训练的轨迹条件评分器，用于自动驾驶生成-选择规划器，在 NAVSIM-v2 上达到 SOTA，在闭环 Bench2Drive 上表现强劲，并提升了 OGBench-Cube 上的操作规划。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶需要在周围交通演变过程中选择安全且高效的行驶方案。生成-选择型规划器会提出多条轨迹并对其评分以供执行，这类方法在NAVSIM基准上已超越了具有代表性的直接预测基线。其评分器必须对从未实际执行的规划方案进行比较。驾驶日志仅记录已执行轨迹的未来信息，因此仅与日志中的未来轨迹进行匹配，会使得对备选方案的预测缺乏约束；相比之下，仿真器可以为每个候选方案标注其执行结果。我们提出了World4Scorer，将评分器构建为一种以轨迹为条件的JEPA风格预测器：它为每个候选方案预测一个状态，并从中读取该候选方案的评分。仿真结果标签用于监督所有候选方案的状态，而已执行轨迹的真实未来信息则将预测器锚定到实际场景演化中。由于一个预测器同时生成所有候选方案的状态，该锚定机制可以约束用于未执行方案评分的共享参数，而未来信息本身仅在训练阶段需要。由于生成的候选方案大多得分较高，场景匹配的样本库会向结果监督中添加低分规划；逐帧选择可能出现冲突，因此引入惯性重排序以保证相邻帧选择的一致性。World4Scorer在NAVSIM-v2基准上取得了最先进的性能，并在闭环Bench2Drive上展现出强大的适配系统结果。在固定LeWM世界模型与规划预算的条件下，基于结果的评分方法还提升了OGBench-Cube基准上的操作规划性能。

title: One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
summary: A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to select the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned selection and realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.
tldr: This paper introduces RoboActualizer, a tiny model with only 60M parameters that learns to select and realize task-conditioned futures from a frozen pretrained video world model, converting them into robot actions via flow matching, without fine-tuning the heavy backbone. It achieves strong performance on simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks with low latency, using 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing world action models and VLAs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RoboActualizer，一个仅有6000万参数的轻量模型，在冻结的预训练视频世界模型之上，学习任务条件下的未来选择与实现，通过流匹配生成机器人动作，无需微调重骨干网络。在仿真基准和真实世界任务上性能优异，延迟低，可训练参数比现有世界动作模型和VLA少100倍。
summary_zh: 预训练的视频世界模型能够为一个场景生成多种合理的未来演变，但机器人必须实现其中特定任务所对应的那一未来。为了将世界模型转化为可执行的机器人策略，现有方法利用大规模机器人数据和计算资源对庞大的世界模型主干进行微调。我们质疑这一现状，认为昂贵的部分在世界模型预训练阶段已经完成，因为视频世界模型的表示空间已经包含了多样的潜在未来。在此情况下，所需要做的仅仅是选择能够完成任务的那一个未来，并读取实现该未来所需的动作。我们将这一任务形式化为“实现”（actualization），即在冻结的世界模型所提供的先验之上，学习一种任务条件下的选择与生成机制。这一问题可以通过一个极小的“实现器”模型来解决。我们在冻结的世界模型编码器之上实现了RoboActualizer，其参数量仅为6000万。该实现器由两个轻量级DiT专家组成，通过流匹配联合预测未来的潜在表示与动作。该模型可在单张GPU上训练，峰值内存仅为32 GB。相较于现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs），RoboActualizer的可训练参数减少了多达100倍，同时在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0等仿真基准以及两个真实机器人平台上的五项任务中均取得了优异表现，其推理延迟仅为39毫秒，能够支持实时控制。

title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving policies are commonly trained via imitation learning on logged demonstrations without observing the consequences of their own actions, leading to causal confusion in closed-loop real-world deployment. To address this issue, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training offers a promising alternative by leveraging world models as interactive training environments to enable future scene generation for policy improvement. Nevertheless, existing approaches either rely on reconstruction-based simulators, offering limited counterfactual interaction, or adopt synthetic simulators to enable long-horizon closed-loop interaction at the cost of a substantial sim-to-real gap. Recently, video world models have exhibited the ability to generate realistic multi-step future rollouts but may not faithfully reflect action conditions, resulting in action-vision mismatch. In this paper, we introduce RoXDrive, a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework that enables reliable policy optimization by identifying action-faithful world-model rollouts, consisting of two stages: 1) Model pre-training: In addition to imitation-based policy pre-training, we devise an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator for inverse dynamics estimation with our geometry-aware auxiliary trajectory supervision, enabling long-horizon assessment of whether visual dynamics faithfully reflect the conditioning ego actions. 2) Action-faithful RL post-training: Agents iteratively interact with world models to form long-horizon scene rollouts, retaining only action-faithful ones for dense safety-aware scoring and scene-level closed-loop RL post-training. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and an in-house dataset with over 130K training scenarios demonstrate consistent gains across planners, reducing safety violations by 27.6% with DiffusionDrive on nuScenes and 33.7% with Qwen3-VL on the internal data.
tldr: RoXDrive introduces a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework for end-to-end autonomous driving, using an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator to filter world-model rollouts that faithfully reflect ego actions, then performing safe RL post-training on those rollouts to reduce safety violations.
tldr_zh: RoXDrive 提出了一种即插即用的闭环强化学习框架，用于端到端自动驾驶，通过“动作-视觉一致性评估器”筛选出忠实反映自我车辆动作的世界模型轨迹，并在此基础上进行安全奖励的强化学习后训练，从而降低安全违规率。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶策略通常通过在记录演示上的模仿学习进行训练，过程中不观察自身行为产生的后果，这导致在闭环实际部署中出现因果混淆。为解决这一问题，强化学习（RL）后训练提供了一种有前景的替代方案，其利用世界模型作为交互式训练环境，实现未来场景生成以促进策略改进。然而，现有方法要么依赖基于重建的模拟器，提供有限的反事实交互；要么采用合成模拟器以支持长时域闭环交互，但代价是存在显著的仿真到现实差距。近期，视频世界模型展现出生成逼真多步未来推演的能力，但可能无法忠实反映动作条件，导致动作与视觉不匹配。本文提出RoXDrive，一种即插即用的闭环RL框架，通过识别动作忠实的世界模型推演实现可靠的策略优化，包含两个阶段：1）模型预训练：在基于模仿的策略预训练之外，我们设计了动作-视觉忠实度评估器，用于逆向动力学估计，并结合我们的几何感知辅助轨迹监督，从而实现对视觉动态是否忠实反映条件化自车动作的长时域评估。2）动作忠实的RL后训练：智能体与世界模型迭代交互以形成长时域场景推演，仅保留动作忠实的推演，用于密集的安全感知评分和场景级闭环RL后训练。在nuScenes及包含超过13万个训练场景的内部数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在不同规划器上均取得一致的性能提升，在nuScenes上将DiffusionDrive的安全违规率降低27.6%，在内部数据上将Qwen3-VL的安全违规率降低33.7%。

title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person's full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse "counterfactual" human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.
tldr: PRISM is a real-to-sim-to-real framework that uses counterfactual video generation to amplify a few real human-object interaction videos into a large diverse training set, enabling a humanoid robot to learn and deploy loco-manipulation policies with only onboard depth observations and without real-world fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: PRISM 是一个真实到仿真再到真实的框架，通过反事实视频生成将少量真实的人-物交互视频扩展为大规模多样化的训练集，使仿人机器人仅依靠机载深度观测即可学习并部署移动操作策略，无需真实世界微调。
summary_zh: 教授人形机器人通过视觉模仿来执行携带多种物体等定位操控技能，是迈向通用机器人的一条有前景的路径。然而，收集多样化、高质量的人机交互视频，例如清晰展示人物全身及无遮挡物体互动的片段，在实践上构成了扩展该方法的障碍。我们提出PRISM，一种从真实到仿真再回到真实的框架，通过将少量真实视频扩展为大规模、多样化的训练集来克服这一限制。PRISM首先利用视频到视频（V2V）生成技术，从少量示例真实视频中生成数百个多样化的“反事实”人机交互视频。随后，我们的接触锚定真值到仿真（real-to-sim）流程同时重建人体和物体的运动，将这些不完美的视频数据转化为物理上可行的轨迹。这些反事实视频内部的类内变异性使我们能够训练出一个策略，该策略可泛化至每个类别内未见过的物体。我们通过在真实机器人上部署该策略来展示完整流程，且无需任何真实世界微调。仅利用机载深度观测，我们的人形机器人便能拾取、搬运并放下物体，包括箱子、桶、垃圾箱和球，覆盖多样的新实例、尺寸及初始构型。

title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.
tldr: ReWAM is a representation-centric world-action model that uses pre-trained DINO features with novel representation shaping techniques to achieve high robot manipulation success without generative video pre-training.
tldr_zh: ReWAM 是一种以表征为中心的世界动作模型，利用预训练的 DINO 特征和新型表征塑造技术，在没有生成式视频预训练的情况下实现了高机器人操作成功率。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型联合学习机器人策略并预测未来观测，使表征空间成为控制与预测之间的接口。我们通过受控比较研究这一空间的设计，发现重建保真度与预训练感知特征均不足以单独确保有效的策略学习。这些发现催生了ReWAM——一种以表征为中心、基于预训练DINO特征构建的世界-动作模型。特征校准与时间表征瓶颈将这些特征组织为适合动力学建模的紧凑世界状态。动作锚定表征塑造仅将动作损失梯度路由至瓶颈，从而使策略塑造表征所编码的内容，而世界模型学习其演化方式。无需生成式视频预训练，ReWAM在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.6%的成功率。在RoboDojo上，利用约600小时的具身预训练数据，其平均得分为12.29，成功率为8.28%。

title: FORM: Robot Manipulation through Direct Material Law Identification
summary: When interacting with an unfamiliar deformable material, a robot lacks prior knowledge of its physical properties and how it will respond to applied forces and motion. Rapid online identification is therefore essential for reliable manipulation. We present FORM (From Observed Response to Material laws), which identifies material properties from a single robot interaction and reuses the recovered model to plan manipulation under new actions and geometries. We use weak-form momentum balance to convert observed material motion and contact forces into linear equations in the unknown material parameters. These equations are assembled using the same material point method discretization as the forward simulator, so identification reduces to linear least-squares solves whose solutions can be used directly for prediction without refitting or conversion. Across four material classes, FORM reduces identification time from roughly 10--25 minutes for iterative baselines to 2--5 seconds, while maintaining competitive accuracy on new motions, initial conditions, and geometries. We demonstrate our approach in simulation and on hardware across four manipulation tasks: elastic rod insertion, golf putting with an elastic club, elastoplastic shaping, and target-volume pouring. In each task, the model identified from a single interaction is reused to plan new motions or manipulate a different geometry. FORM estimates elastic properties within 3.4% and elastoplastic properties within 2%, achieves 72.4--77.8% IoU in dough shaping, and keeps mean pouring error at 3.8 mL across target volumes of 60--160 mL.
tldr: FORM identifies deformable material properties from a single robot interaction via weak-form momentum balance and least squares, enabling rapid replanning for manipulation tasks like insertion, golf putting, shaping, and pouring.
tldr_zh: FORM通过弱形式动量平衡和最小二乘法，从单次机器人交互中识别可变形材料属性，并快速重规划以完成插入、高尔夫推杆、塑形和倒水等操作任务。
summary_zh: 在与不熟悉的变形材料交互时，机器人缺乏对其物理特性以及在施加力和运动时如何响应的先验知识。因此，快速在线识别对于可靠操作至关重要。我们提出了FORM（从观测响应到材料定律），该方法能够从单次机器人交互中识别材料属性，并复用所恢复的模型来规划在新动作和几何条件下的操作。我们利用弱形式动量平衡将观测到的材料运动和接触力转换为关于未知材料参数的线性方程。这些方程使用与前向模拟器相同的物质点法离散化进行组装，因此识别问题简化为线性最小二乘求解，其解可直接用于预测，无需重新拟合或转换。在四类材料中，FORM将识别时间从迭代基线的约10至25分钟缩短至2至5秒，同时在新运动、初始条件和几何条件下保持具有竞争力的精度。我们在仿真和硬件上验证了该方法，涵盖四项操作任务：弹性杆插入、弹性杆高尔夫推杆、弹塑性成型和目标体积倾倒。在每项任务中，从单次交互中识别出的模型被复用于规划新运动或操作不同几何形状的物体。FORM对弹性属性的估计误差在3.4%以内，弹塑性属性误差在2%以内，在面团成型任务中实现了72.4%至77.8%的交并比，并在60至160 mL的目标体积范围内将平均倾倒误差保持在3.8 mL。

title: CrossBFM: Distilling a Shared Latent Behavior Space Across Humanoid Embodiments
summary: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) give humanoids a promptable policy over a latent behavior space, enabling one single vector to represent a motion to imitate, a pose to reach, or a reward to maximize. Forward-Backward representations successfully produce such spaces, but at the cost of hundreds of GPU-hours for a single robot. Moreover, when the training process is repeated for a second robot, it produces a second space unrelated to the first, resulting in embodiment-specific latents that do not unify or transfer. We address these problems with CrossBFM, treating the latent space as the transferable asset for various embodiments. As retargeting provides frame-level cross-embodiment correspondence, we propose a unified encoder architecture with no robot-specific parameters for distilling the behavior space to address all training embodiments simultaneously in less than a GPU-hour. Following this encoder, latent-conditioned trackers turn the distilled latent into whole-body control in a conventional PPO training manner in just 10 more GPU-hours. On three distilled humanoids, all three prompting modes transfer: motion tracking with latent-conditioned policy losing only $0.025$ rad to its joint-conditioned counterpart, smooth goal reaching between poses with no falls, and reward optimization for all $41$ reward prompts. Our experiments further reveal that 1) regressing the encoder on a quarter of the motion corpus costs only $5\%$ of tracking performance and 2) training the encoder on a subset of robots and evaluating on an unseen one recovers up to $89\%$ of the tracking performance of seen robots, demonstrating cross-embodiment generalization to morphologically similar robots. We also verify the pipeline on real robots across all three prompting modes and with flow-based generated latents. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/crossbfm/
tldr: CrossBFM distills a shared latent behavior space across multiple humanoid embodiments in under an hour, enabling transferable motion tracking, goal reaching, and reward optimization with a single unified encoder.
tldr_zh: CrossBFM在不到一小时内跨多个人形机器人提炼出共享的潜在行为空间，通过统一编码器实现了可迁移的运动跟踪、目标到达和奖励优化。
summary_zh: 行为基础模型（BFMs）为仿人机器人提供了一个基于潜在行为空间的可提示策略，使得单个向量即可表示待模仿的动作、待到达的姿态或待最大化的奖励。前向-反向表征成功构建了此类空间，但代价是单个机器人需要数百GPU小时的训练时间。此外，当针对第二个机器人重复训练过程时，会产生与第一个机器人无关的第二个空间，从而得到针对特定具体形态的潜在表征，无法实现统一或迁移。我们通过CrossBFM解决这些问题，将潜在空间视为适用于多种具体形态的可迁移资产。由于重定向提供了帧级别的跨具体形态对应关系，我们提出了一种无机器人特定参数的统一编码器架构，用于蒸馏行为空间，从而在不到一个GPU小时内同时处理所有训练具体形态。在该编码器之后，潜在条件跟踪器以传统PPO训练方式在仅10个额外GPU小时内将蒸馏后的潜在表征转化为全身控制。在三个蒸馏后的仿人机器人上，所有三种提示模式均成功迁移：潜在条件策略的动作跟踪相比其关节条件对应策略仅损失$0.025$弧度；姿态间平滑目标到达无摔倒；所有$41$个奖励提示的奖励优化均成功完成。我们的实验进一步揭示：1）在动作语料库的四分之一上回归编码器仅损失$5\%$的跟踪性能；2）在部分机器人子集上训练编码器并在未见过的机器人上评估，可恢复已见机器人跟踪性能的至多$89\%$，展示了面向形态相似机器人的跨具体形态泛化能力。我们还通过三种提示模式以及基于流的生成潜在表征在真实机器人上验证了该流程。项目网站：https://dotandung.github.io/crossbfm/

title: MotorMind: Scaffolding General Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robotic manipulation, but their zero-shot generalization in new tasks and environments remains limited, and their reliance on specialized training keeps them from benefiting directly from rapidly advancing general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs). In parallel, recent agentic robotic systems leverage VLMs for high-level reasoning or coding agents for robot control, but often depend on extensive external models and tools, introducing additional complexity and cost. This motivates us to ask: Can a general-purpose VLM itself operate a robot more like the human teleoperator by reasoning directly from observations, issuing actions, and continuously adapting to execution feedback, without relying on external models such as learned action experts, coding agents or grounding tools like SAM3? In this work, we introduce MotorMind, a robot manipulation harness that connects VLM-proposed mid-level actions to deterministic robot control and feedback, with asynchronous monitoring and background memory updates. Without task-specific policy training, coding agents, or additional grounding tools such as SAM3, MotorMind achieves 66.7% success on the base LIBERO-PRO suites and 53.8% under perturbations, compared with at most 13.3% and 19.2%, respectively, for the prior zero-shot methods we evaluate. The same interface reaches 95% average success on a real xArm6 robot across direct manipulation and human-perturbation settings. Replacing the backbone with a stronger VLM further improves performance, while the remaining failures - primarily due to visual grounding, embodied reasoning, and action knowledge - decrease as VLM capability improves. These results show that a general-purpose VLM, when equipped with an appropriate mid-level action representation and asynchronous execution harness, can perform effective zero-shot robotic manipulation.
tldr: MotorMind presents a harness that enables general-purpose VLMs to perform zero-shot robot manipulation by converting VLM-proposed mid-level actions into deterministic control, achieving strong success rates without task-specific training or external tools.
tldr_zh: MotorMind 提出了一种框架，使通用视觉语言模型能够通过将其中级动作转换为确定性控制来实现零样本机器人操作，无需任务特定训练或外部工具即可获得较高成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作技术的进步，但它们在新型任务和环境中的零样本泛化能力仍然有限，且其对专门训练的依赖使其无法直接受益于快速发展的通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）。与此同时，近期基于智能体的机器人系统利用VLM进行高层推理，或利用编码智能体进行机器人控制，但往往依赖大量外部模型和工具，从而引入了额外的复杂性和成本。这促使我们提出一个问题：通用VLM本身能否更像人类远程操作员那样，通过直接基于观察进行推理、发出动作并持续适应执行反馈来操作机器人，而无需依赖外部模型，如学习型动作专家、编码智能体或SAM3等接地工具？在本工作中，我们引入了MotorMind——一种机器人操作框架，将VLM提出的中层动作与确定性机器人控制和反馈相连接，并具备异步监控和后台记忆更新功能。在无任务特定策略训练、编码智能体或SAM3等额外接地工具的条件下，MotorMind在基础LIBERO-PRO任务集上达到66.7%的成功率，在扰动条件下达到53.8%，而我们评估的先前零样本方法分别最多仅为13.3%和19.2%。同一接口在真实xArm6机器人上的直接操作和人为扰动场景中平均成功率高达95%。用更强的VLM替换骨干模型可进一步提升性能，而剩余的主要失败原因——视觉接地、具身推理和动作知识——随着VLM能力的增强而减少。这些结果表明，通用VLM在配备合适的中层动作表示和异步执行框架时，能够实现有效的零样本机器人操作。

title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot--object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning. More results are available at \href{https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/}{project page}.
tldr: WorldLine is an action-driven visual simulator for robotic manipulation that decouples dynamics learning from action grounding using a shared image-space action representation, enabling scalable policy evaluation and planning across embodiments.
tldr_zh: WorldLine 是一种用于机器人操作的动作驱动视觉模拟器，通过共享的图像空间动作表示将动力学学习与动作基础解耦，实现了跨本体的可扩展策略评估和规划。
summary_zh: 真实世界中的机器人学习受限于采集经验和评估候选行为的成本。视频生成模型为视觉模拟器提供了可扩展的基础，使其能够在物理执行之前预测动作结果。然而，这类模型往往更倾向于视觉合理性，而非精确的动作跟随和连贯的机器人-物体动态关系；同时，基于动作条件的模拟器依赖于稀缺的、特定具身形态的数据，这些数据难以在不兼容的控制空间之间共享。我们提出WorldLine，一种由动作驱动的视觉模拟器，将可迁移的动态学习与异构动作基础解耦。WorldLine从超过10,000小时无动作的机器人视频中学习操作动态，并利用来自十余种具身形态的2,000多小时动作轨迹对其加以锚定。一种图像空间动作表示为不同具身形态提供了共享的控制接口，而多视图与失败增强训练结合关系正则化则提升了交互敏感预测能力。面向机器人的少步蒸馏使得高效因果推演成为可能，同时保留动作关键运动。在留出设置和域外设置中，WorldLine均保持了较强的视觉质量和机器人运动一致性；在失败轨迹上，其机器人掩膜IoU较最强基线提升了0.1626。在RoboTwin和AgiBot上，其轨迹成功预测的平均准确率为74%，较最强基线高出1个百分点。在未经RoboTwin训练或适配的情况下，其推演结果使任务成功率较直接策略执行最高提升21.4个百分点。综合来看，这些能力使WorldLine成为面向策略评估和具身规划的可扩展、高效视觉模拟器。更多结果可访问项目页面：\href{https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/}{项目主页}。

title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. Passenger intent may span multiple stages of behavior, depend on future events, refer to surrounding agents or landmarks, and remain relevant as driving conditions evolve. Existing language-enabled driving datasets largely focus on short, localized interactions, leaving these longer-horizon forms of passenger intent comparatively underexplored. We introduce doPlan, to our knowledge the first publicly available, human-annotated real-world dataset designed to study passenger language as persistent task context. Built on nuPlan, doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique driving, with annotation windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. The annotations capture immediate, deferred, event-conditioned, persistent, and multi-stage passenger intent. The dataset, annotation interface, and supporting resources are publicly available at https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan. We evaluate four language-conditioned driving models and find that sensitivity to passenger language does not reliably translate into behavior consistent with the requested direction. More broadly, among 2,161 examples with a matched future maneuver, the first associated maneuver occurs a median of 24.6 s after the evaluation point, and only 9.8% occur within the models' common 5 s prediction horizon. These findings highlight the need to connect persistent passenger intent with successive planning decisions. doPlan provides a setting for studying how unresolved goals can be retained, grounded in evolving scenes, and tracked across multiple stages, including how a planner determines when a future goal becomes relevant to the current plan.
tldr: Introduces doPlan, the first publicly available human-annotated real-world dataset for multi-stage, language-conditioned planning in autonomous driving, featuring long-horizon passenger instructions and an evaluation of four language-conditioned driving models, highlighting the gap between language understanding and behavior consistency.
tldr_zh: 介绍了 doPlan，这是首个公开的、人工标注的、用于自动驾驶中多阶段语言条件规划的真实世界数据集，包含长时间跨度的乘客指令，并评估了四种语言条件驾驶模型，揭示了语言理解与行为一致性之间的差距。
summary_zh: 自主车辆通过自然语言与乘客交互时，其推理必须超越即时指令的范畴。乘客意图可能跨越多个行为阶段，依赖于未来事件，涉及周围交通参与者或地标，并且随着驾驶条件的变化而持续相关。现有具备语言能力的驾驶数据集主要集中在短时、局部交互上，使得这些长时域形式的乘客意图相对未被充分探索。我们引入了doPlan——据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的、经人工标注的真实世界数据集，旨在研究乘客语言作为持续性任务上下文的作用。doPlan基于nuPlan构建，包含5,154条人工撰写的乘客指令，覆盖169.1小时的累计指令对齐上下文，对应50.9小时的独立驾驶数据，标注窗口范围为30.0至508.8秒。标注内容涵盖即时、延迟、事件条件触发、持续性和多阶段乘客意图。该数据集、标注界面及相关支持资源已在https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan公开提供。我们评估了四种语言条件驾驶模型，发现模型对乘客语言的敏感性并不能可靠地转化为与所请求方向一致的行为。更广泛地，在2,161个具有匹配未来操作轨迹的样本中，首个关联操作在评估点之后的中位时间为24.6秒，且仅有9.8%的操作出现在模型常见的5秒预测范围内。这些发现突显了将持续性乘客意图与连续规划决策相连接的必要性。doPlan为研究未解决目标如何在不断演变的场景中被保留、落地并在多个阶段中被跟踪提供了一个实验平台，包括规划器如何确定未来目标何时与当前计划相关。

title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
summary: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.
tldr: Brain-SAD introduces a safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints and dual-policy optimization, demonstrating improved safety and efficiency in continuous intersection scenarios.
tldr_zh: Brain-SAD 提出了一种具有动态恐惧导向约束和双策略优化的安全自动驾驶控制框架，在连续交叉路口场景中展示了更高的安全性和效率。
summary_zh: 约束强化学习近年来在安全自动驾驶领域引起了越来越多的关注，其通用机制是在保持整体行动风险有界的同时最大化期望回报。通过这种方式，自动驾驶中产生的安全问题可以通过约束动作得到缓解。然而，现有的约束强化学习方法在施加的约束上仍缺乏动态性。例如，现有的原始-对偶/软约束方法所采用的动作成本通常被定义为静态的状态到成本映射，而硬约束方法中的安全动作投影依赖于从离线演示中估计的固定可行域边界进行静态投影。上述缺点将施加的约束与训练场景紧密耦合，使得自动驾驶策略难以处理不同的交互场景，原因是存在不恰当的状态级动作成本和静态投影边界。因此，本文提出了Brain-SAD，一种具有动态恐惧导向约束的脑启发式安全自动驾驶控制框架。通过感知当前的车辆交互场景，Brain-SAD生成动态恐惧信号作为恐惧反应，以在线决策用于常规交互的长期策略或用于紧急碰撞防御的短期策略。在这两种策略中，上述恐惧反应将被构建为动态恐惧约束，分别反映与动作影响直接耦合的整体恐惧成本，以及源自不同风险邻近车辆的可行域动态恐惧边界，两者都将反过来服务于在线策略优化。实验结果表明，Brain-SAD优于现有方法，在更短的任务完成时间和碰撞恢复时间内实现了更高的成功率，并在复杂度波动的连续交叉口中表现出更强的可靠性。

title: ExceptionDrive: A Planning-Oriented Counterfactual Corner-Case Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
summary: Average performance on routine driving benchmarks does not establish planner reliability under rare, safety-critical hazards. We proposed ExceptionDrive, a counterfactual planning benchmark that uses VLM-assisted screening, localized multi-view editing, and quality auditing to insert hazards into real nuScenes scenes while preserving their context. Its 21 tasks span six safety families and define hazard or conflict regions, local safety constraints, and acceptable responses. Because hazard insertion can invalidate the recorded human trajectory, our reference-free protocol evaluates edited predictions using Unsafe Rate (UR), Hazard Clearance Compliance (HCC), Hazard Proximity Response (HPR), and Counterfactual Trajectory Shift (CTS), which measure core-region intrusion, clearance compliance, clearance relative to a prescribed margin, and counterfactual trajectory change. Seven representative planners frequently intrude into hazard regions or provide insufficient clearance. We also develop a Reminder Agent that, without sample-specific task labels, converts visual evidence and the shared taxonomy into structured records of hazard presence, type, and a recommended high-level strategy. The agent neither predicts trajectories nor controls the vehicle; its records guide a VLM-based decision agent. In zero-shot experiments, the reminders improve strategy accuracy and reduce under-warning.
tldr: ExceptionDrive introduces a counterfactual benchmark for autonomous driving planning that inserts hazards into real nuScenes scenes via VLM-assisted editing, with new metrics and a Reminder Agent to improve VLM-based decision strategies.
tldr_zh: ExceptionDrive 提出了一个用于自动驾驶规划的反事实基准，通过 VLM 辅助编辑在真实 nuScenes 场景中插入危险，并引入新指标和提醒代理以增强 VLM 决策。
summary_zh: 平均性能在常规驾驶基准测试中并不能体现规划器在罕见安全关键危险情况下的可靠性。我们提出了ExceptionDrive，一个反事实规划基准，利用VLM辅助筛选、局部多视角编辑和质量审计，在保持真实nuScenes场景上下文的同时插入危险情况。其21项任务涵盖六个安全类别，并定义了危险或冲突区域、局部安全约束及可接受的响应。由于插入危险可能使记录的人类轨迹失效，我们的无参考协议通过不安全率（UR）、危险清除合规性（HCC）、危险接近响应（HPR）和反事实轨迹偏移（CTS）来评估编辑后的预测，这些指标分别衡量核心区域侵入、清除合规性、相对于规定余量的清除距离以及反事实轨迹变化。七个代表性规划器经常侵入危险区域或提供不足的清除距离。我们还开发了一个提醒代理，无需样本特定的任务标签，即可将视觉证据和共享分类法转化为关于危险存在、类型及推荐高层策略的结构化记录。该代理既不预测轨迹也不控制车辆；其记录用于指导基于VLM的决策代理。在零样本实验中，提醒功能提高了策略准确性并减少了警告不足的情况。

title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. To improve loop efficiency, we complement vision with tactile feedback to reduce uncertainty during physical interaction. We further augment textual guidance with reusable code to reduce reasoning overhead during skill reuse. On LIBERO-10, RoboSkill improves first-episode success rates by 12.5--25.0 percentage points and reduces average runtime by 7.6--72.4% across four agents. On real robots, it improves success rates by 8.3 percentage points and reduces average runtime for successful trials by at least 14.4%.
tldr: RoboSkill introduces an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop enabling embodied agents to acquire and reuse skills, improving first-episode success and runtime on LIBERO-10 and real robots by combining vision, tactile feedback, and reusable code.
tldr_zh: RoboSkill 提出了一种“探索、执行、进化”循环，让具身智能体能够获取并复用技能，通过结合视觉、触觉反馈和可复用代码，在 LIBERO-10 和真实机器人上提升了首次成功率并减少了运行时间。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型在机器人领域展现了令人印象深刻的能力，但其对未见任务的泛化能力仍具挑战性。近年来，通用多模态智能体在零样本机器人任务求解方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，这类智能体往往需要从零开始对物理世界进行推理和探索，导致较高的执行成本。为降低这些成本，我们提出了RoboSkill，一个通过“探索、执行、演化”循环将技能获取与复用相连接的框架。在该循环中，智能体通过探索收集任务相关信息，在执行任务时根据反馈进行适应，并基于执行记录演化其技能库。随后，它复用这些技能以指导下一轮循环中的探索与执行，从而形成闭环。为提升循环效率，我们在视觉感知基础上引入触觉反馈，以降低物理交互过程中的不确定性；同时，在文本引导中补充可复用代码，以减少技能复用时的推理开销。在LIBERO-10上，RoboSkill在四种智能体上将首次执行成功率提高了12.5至25.0个百分点，并将平均运行时间缩短了7.6%至72.4%。在真实机器人上，其将成功率提高了8.3个百分点，并在成功试验中将平均运行时间至少缩短14.4%。

title: MVG-WAM: Multiple View Geometry-Aware World-Action Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics with action prediction, bringing the rich priors of pretrained video models to robotic manipulation. However, their multi-view interfaces typically tile images or concatenate tokens, leaving the geometric relationships among synchronized cameras implicit. This makes it harder to connect global scene context with the local geometry required for interaction. We introduce the Multi-View Geometry-Aware World-Action Model (MVG-WAM), which organizes these observations as related projections of one physical world rather than separate images on a canvas. Our model combines an epipolar-constrained global state with view-indexed geometric states jointly inferred from synchronized observations. Camera-aware routing supplies each video region with its corresponding geometric context and the shared global state, explicitly structuring the representation used for action prediction. We further ground the geometry-aware representation in metric scale through multi-horizon future-depth supervision, without requiring depth decoding during action rollout. MVG-WAM achieves average success rates of 99.1% on LIBERO and 92.07% on RoboTwin 2.0, demonstrating competitive performance across both benchmarks. Real-world experiments on Cobot Magic further demonstrate a 91.3% success rate across 150 trials spanning three manipulation tasks.
tldr: MVG-WAM introduces a multi-view geometry-aware World-Action Model that explicitly models epipolar constraints and geometric states for robotic manipulation, achieving high success rates on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world trials.
tldr_zh: MVG-WAM 提出了一种多视图几何感知的世界-动作模型，通过显式建模极线约束和几何状态来提升机器人操控性能，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实世界实验中均取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）将视觉动态与动作预测相结合，将预训练视频模型的丰富先验知识引入机器人操作领域。然而，其多视角接口通常采用图像拼接或令牌拼接的方式，使得同步相机之间的几何关系隐含不清。这增加了将全局场景上下文与交互所需的局部几何信息相连接的难度。我们提出了多视角几何感知世界-动作模型（MVG-WAM），该模型将这些观测组织为同一物理世界的相关投影，而非画布上的独立图像。我们的模型将极线约束的全局状态与视角索引的几何状态相结合，两者均从同步观测中联合推断得出。相机感知路由为每个视频区域提供相应的几何上下文及共享全局状态，从而显式地构建用于动作预测的表示。通过多时域未来深度监督，我们进一步将几何感知表示锚定在度量尺度上，且在动作推理过程中无需深度解码。MVG-WAM在LIBERO基准上实现了99.1%的平均成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0基准上实现了92.07%的平均成功率，展现出在两个基准上的竞争性表现。在Cobot Magic上的真实世界实验中，涵盖三项操作任务共150次试验，成功率高达91.3%。

title: Geometry-Preserving Human-to-Robot Upper-Body Motion Retargeting from Monocular Video
summary: Monocular RGB video provides an accessible source of human demonstrations for upper-body robot motion, yet video-driven human-to-robot transfer remains challenging because body and hand motion are recovered at different spatial scales, human and robot kinematics differ substantially, and fine distal motion is difficult to preserve across embodiments. We present a geometry-preserving motion-retargeting framework that integrates unified body--hand reconstruction with morphology-independent geometric transfer. Frame-wise body estimates, video-level observations, and detailed hand evidence jointly constrain a single differentiable Momentum Human Rig (MHR) state, while transient hand artifacts are repaired in parameter space. The reconstructed motion is represented by arm-segment directions, elbow configuration, relative palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations, and is realized on the target robot through multi-stage inverse kinematics and robot-specific hand adaptation. Within the broader system, Across-VAM provides video generation, whereas Across-WAM performs human-to-robot motion mapping. The method is evaluated on 16 monocular videos comprising 1,769 source frames, including 10 signing and six reach-to-grasp sequences. Unified reconstruction reduces mean hand reprojection error from 22.36 to 7.21 pixels relative to SAM 3D Body. All 16 retargeted trajectories completed kinematic simulation playback, and representative signing and reach-to-grasp motions were further demonstrated on a physical robot. The results demonstrate a unified pipeline from monocular human video to coordinated upper-body motion on a dual-arm dexterous robot.
tldr: This paper presents a geometry-preserving framework for retargeting human upper-body and hand motions from monocular RGB video to a dual-arm dexterous robot, integrating unified body-hand reconstruction and morphology-independent geometric transfer, validated in simulation and on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种几何保持的框架，用于将单目RGB视频中的人体上半身和手部运动重定向到双臂灵巧机器人，集成了统一的身体-手部重建和与形态无关的几何迁移，并在仿真和物理机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 单目RGB视频为上半身机器人运动提供了易于获取的人体演示来源，然而，由于身体与手部运动在不同空间尺度上被恢复、人体与机器人运动学存在显著差异，以及精细的末端运动难以在跨实体间保持，视频驱动的人到机器人迁移仍具挑战性。我们提出了一种保持几何特性的运动重定向框架，该框架将统一的身体-手部重建与不依赖形态的几何迁移相结合。逐帧身体估计、视频级观察和详细的手部证据共同约束一个可微分的Momentum Human Rig (MHR)状态，同时，瞬态手部伪影在参数空间中被修复。重建的运动以手臂段方向、肘部构型、相对手掌方向及双侧腕部关系来表示，并通过多阶段逆运动学与机器人特定的手部适配在目标机器人上实现。在更广泛的系统范围内，Across-VAM负责视频生成，而Across-WAM执行人到机器人的运动映射。该方法在包含1,769个源帧的16个单目视频上进行了评估，其中包括10个手语序列和6个伸手抓取序列。与SAM 3D Body相比，统一重建将平均手部重投影误差从22.36像素降至7.21像素。所有16个重定向轨迹均完成了运动学仿真回放，具有代表性的手语和伸手抓取运动进一步在实体机器人上进行了演示。结果表明，该框架实现了从单目人体视频到双臂灵巧机器人协调上半身运动的统一流程。

title: Urgent Actions Go First: Urgency-Aware Denoising for Real-Time VLA Control
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks through iterative denoising, incurring substantial inference latency that severely limits real-time robotic control. Existing acceleration methods treat an action chunk as a monolithic computational unit, ignoring a crucial physical reality of receding-horizon control: actions are generated jointly but consumed sequentially, resulting in inherently heterogeneous execution urgencies. We exploit this asymmetry to introduce Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD), a novel inference-time framework that allocates denoising computation according to when each action is physically needed. UAD releases time-critical urgent actions after fewer denoising steps while overlapping the continued background refinement of tail actions with physical execution. However, heterogeneous denoising introduces two key challenges: early-release errors in urgent actions and trajectory inconsistency in tail actions. UAD elegantly resolves both through two core mechanisms: Trajectory Reconciliation, which reconstructs unified internal state evolution to restore joint denoising coherence without additional model evaluations, and Ghost Action Correction, which leverages non-executed ghost continuations to dynamically compensate for early-release errors across remaining executable actions. Extensive evaluations across multiple VLA architectures, simulation benchmarks, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UAD achieves up to a 1.89x speedup in average action availability latency while maintaining comparable success rates to vanilla inference with optimal denoising budget, offering a more favorable success-latency trade-off than state-of-the-art VLA acceleration baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD), an inference-time framework for diffusion/flow-matching VLA policies that allocates denoising computation based on action execution urgency. UAD releases time-critical actions early and refines tail actions during execution, achieving significant latency speedups while maintaining success rates, validated across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为UAD的推理时框架，用于扩散/流匹配VLA策略，根据动作执行的紧迫性分配去噪计算。UAD提前释放紧急动作并利用执行时间细化尾部动作，在显著降低延迟的同时保持成功率，并在仿真和真实世界操作任务中得到了验证。
summary_zh: 扩散与流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过迭代去噪生成动作块，带来了显著的推理延迟，严重限制了实时机器人控制。现有加速方法将动作块视为一个整体计算单元，忽略了后退时域控制中一个关键的物理现实：动作是联合生成但按序执行的，因此存在本质上异构的执行紧迫性。我们利用这一不对称性，提出了紧迫性感知去噪（UAD），这是一种新颖的推理时框架，根据每个动作实际需要的时间分配去噪计算。UAD在较少的去噪步骤后释放时间关键的紧迫动作，同时将尾部动作的持续后台优化与物理执行重叠进行。然而，异构去噪引入了两个关键挑战：紧迫动作的早期释放误差和尾部动作的轨迹不一致性。UAD通过两个核心机制优雅地解决了这两个问题：轨迹调和，重构统一的内部状态演化以恢复联合去噪的一致性，无需额外的模型评估；以及幽灵动作修正，利用不执行的幽灵延续动态补偿剩余可执行动作中的早期释放误差。跨多种VLA架构、仿真基准和真实世界操控任务的广泛评估表明，UAD在平均动作可用延迟上实现了高达1.89倍的加速，同时保持了与具有最优去噪预算的原始推理相当的成功率，相较于最先进的VLA加速基线，提供了更优的成功率-延迟权衡。

title: Faster and Better? Benchmark Bugs and Design Limitations Distort the Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Acceleration
summary: Simulated manipulation benchmarks are the standard tool for evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the acceleration methods that reduce their inference latency for on-robot deployment. On these benchmarks, we observe that some training-free acceleration methods, which approximate the baseline policy's computation, achieve higher measured success rates than the baseline itself. Success rates alone cannot establish whether such gains come from better task execution or from evaluation flaws. We therefore investigate two kinds of benchmark flaws behind these gains: bugs, where the implementation does not match the intended task or evaluation protocol, and design limitations, where success criteria and simulation settings do not fully capture how acceleration affects task execution. Starting from tasks with anomalous gains, we localize root causes by plotting object trajectories against checker acceptance regions, and classify the resulting bugs into task consistency, initialization, and reproducibility. Extending this audit to seven benchmarks, including RoboTwin, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench, we identify 22 bugs of these types and 4 design limitations.
