tldr: RoboChrono is a new benchmark for streaming task understanding in robot manipulation, comprising real robot executions and evaluating 18 VLM models on recognition, alignment, and temporal grounding tasks, revealing a gap between visual matching and temporal ordering abilities.
tldr_zh: RoboChrono是一个用于机器人操作中流式任务理解的新基准，包含真实机器人执行数据，评估了18个VLM模型在识别、对齐和时间定位任务上的表现，揭示了视觉匹配与时间排序能力之间的差距。
summary_zh: 理解持续的机器人操作需要模型将视觉观察与交互历史和任务进度关联起来进行解读。我们提出了RoboChrono，一个用于流式任务理解的基准测试，包含39个场景和34,713个评估实例，数据来源于真实机器人执行过程以及互补的裸手人类录制的视频。该基准涵盖七项任务，归为识别、对齐和时间定位三大类，涉及动作理解与预测、视觉对应、时间排序以及动作定位。对18个视觉语言模型的零样本评估揭示了不同任务间的显著差异。GPT-6-Astra在帧匹配任务上达到98.3%的准确率，但在帧排序任务上仅为68.3%；而RynnBrain1.1-122B-A10B在这些任务上的差距更大，分别达到95.4%和32.9%。针对五个开放权重模型的匹配问题输入消融实验进一步揭示了模型对视觉证据的不同依赖程度：移除视觉观察后，当前动作识别准确率下降了22.1个百分点，而下一动作预测仅下降了0.7个百分点。这些发现表明，强大的视觉匹配能力并不总是与强大的时间排序能力保持一致，并提示下一动作预测在缺乏视觉证据时仍可依托任务和动作先验得到支持。RoboChrono为考察这些差异提供了一个诊断性环境，强调了在评估机器人操作任务理解时，除总体分数外还需进行面向能力的专项评估的必要性。

title: Executor-aware Candidate Selection via a Feasibility Certificate
summary:
Modular robotic systems often separate motion planning from a downstream executor that enforces state-dependent hard constraints. A candidate that is geometrically valid may therefore be incompatible with the executor's available command set. We present a certificate-based candidate-selection framework that constructs a command witness from the executor hard set at predicted rollout states and verifies it against the original constraints, without changing candidate generation, ranking, or the executor.
  Across 5,085 geometry-valid numerical evaluations on two robot models, 795 admitted no executor-feasible command. The certificate is sufficient but conservative: none of the 795 was certified, while 7.09\% of reference-feasible cases remained uncertified. In controlled FR3 and fixed-base RB-Y1 simulations, certificate admission frequently changed candidate selection, and a post-hoc exact linear-programming (LP) admission baseline revealed platform-dependent conservatism. Relative to geometry-based selection, certificate admission was associated with lower planner-command coverage and higher nominal tracking error, without a consistent advantage in reached-state interaction reserve. A planner-generated MoveIt/OMPL study further evaluates the same admission rule on externally generated candidate pools.
tldr: This paper introduces a certificate-based framework for selecting motion-planning candidates that verifies whether a candidate is executable by a downstream executor with hard state-dependent constraints, improving feasibility in modular robotic systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于证书的候选选择框架，用于验证运动规划候选是否可由具有硬状态依赖约束的下游执行器执行，从而提高模块化机器人系统的可行性。
summary_zh:
模块化机器人系统通常将运动规划与下游执行器分离，后者负责实施依赖于状态变量的硬约束。因此，几何上有效的候选轨迹可能无法兼容执行器可用的命令集。本文提出了一种基于证书的候选选择框架，该框架在预测的滚动状态点上，从执行器硬约束集中构造命令见证，并根据原始约束对其进行验证，而无需修改候选生成、排序或执行器本身。

在对两种机器人模型进行的5,085次几何有效性数值评估中，795次未接受任何执行器可行的命令。该证书条件充分但保守：795次中无一通过认证，而参考可行情况中有7.09%仍未被认证。在受控FR3和固定基座RB-Y1仿真中，证书认证经常改变候选选择结果，且事后精确线性规划（LP）认证基线揭示了平台相关的保守性。与基于几何的选择相比，证书认证与较低的规划器命令覆盖率和较高的名义跟踪误差相关，而在到达状态的交互裕度方面并无一致优势。一项由规划器生成的MoveIt/OMPL研究在外部生成的候选池上进一步评估了相同的认证规则。

title: Inferring Soil Friction Angle from Robot Foot-Ground Force Histories: A Bayesian Inverse Approach to Proprioceptive Soil Sensing
summary: Foot-ground interaction signals recorded by quadruped robots may enable spatially distributed, in situ characterization of soil strength. As a first step, we test whether the internal friction angle $φ$ of cohesionless soil can be identified from the force history of a simplified rotating leg. A two-dimensional continuum model implemented with the material point method, benchmarked against measured rotating-leg force histories, generates the training data, and two Gaussian-process surrogates support Bayesian inversion of the full histories. In matched-model experiments, the framework recovers 14 off-grid friction angles with a median absolute error of approximately $0.1^\circ$ (maximum $\sim 0.7^\circ$); the reported credible intervals contain the true value in every case. These results establish that $φ$ is identifiable when the forward model is correctly specified, and support further development of proprioceptive soil sensing for spatially variable terrain, with applications from physics-grounded world models for robot training to post-wildfire slope assessment.
tldr: This paper uses Bayesian inversion with Gaussian-process surrogates trained on material point method simulations to identify soil friction angles from quadruped robot foot-ground force histories, achieving high accuracy in matched-model experiments and supporting proprioceptive soil sensing.
tldr_zh: 本文利用基于物质点法模拟训练的GP代理模型和贝叶斯反演，从四足机器人足地力历史中识别土壤内摩擦角，在匹配模型实验中实现了高精度，支持本体感觉土壤感知。
summary_zh: 四足机器人记录的脚-地面交互信号可能实现对土壤强度的空间分布式原位表征。作为第一步，我们测试是否可以从简化旋转腿的力历史中识别出无粘性土的内摩擦角$\phi$。采用物质点法实现的二维连续介质模型，以实测旋转腿力历史为基准生成训练数据，两个高斯过程代理模型支持对完整力历史的贝叶斯反演。在匹配模型实验中，该框架恢复了14个离网格摩擦角，中位绝对误差约为$0.1^\circ$（最大约$0.7^\circ$）；所报告的置信区间在每种情况下均包含真实值。这些结果证实，在前向模型正确指定的前提下，$\phi$是可识别的，并支持面向空间变化地形的本体感觉土壤传感的进一步开发，其应用涵盖从基于物理的机器人训练世界模型到火灾后边坡评估。

title: Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation
summary: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.
tldr: This paper proposes a teacher-student distillation framework that transfers safety behaviors from a privileged Control Barrier Function teacher to an RGB-only student filter, enabling safe dynamic visual navigation without 3D reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种师生蒸馏框架，将特权控制屏障函数教师的安全行为迁移到仅使用RGB的学生滤波器，实现无需3D重建的动态视觉导航安全。
summary_zh: 仅使用RGB的端到端视觉导航策略在真实世界动态环境中仍易发生碰撞，因此需要专门的安全层。现有的基于视觉的控制屏障函数（CBF）方法试图从RGB观测中提供安全保障，但往往依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建，且主要针对静态场景设计，限制了其在机载部署中的实用性。我们提出了一种教师-学生视觉蒸馏框架，将特权CBF教师的安全行为迁移至仅使用RGB的学生滤波器中，以适用于动态环境。学生网络直接将短时RGB历史、机器人速度以及标称控制动作映射为安全动作，而教师网络则在真实到仿真的动态高斯泼溅环境中使用地面真值机器人状态和障碍物状态。为缩小教师-学生之间的信息差距，教师仅基于学生RGB历史中可观测到的障碍物构建安全约束，同时考虑障碍物速度的不确定性以增强对运动变化的鲁棒性；此外，动作增强机制使学生网络暴露于多样化的安全与不安全标称动作中，从而更准确地学习安全边界。在部署阶段，学生网络仅需RGB观测和机器人速度，无需显式三维重建或在线渲染。实验结果表明，所提方法优于基于视觉的CBF基线方法，并在动态障碍物运动条件下显著提升了基于RGB的导航策略的安全性。项目主页：https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/。

title: LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes?
summary: Robots must often continue a task after a target moves, the viewpoint shifts, or an obstacle appears, even though their earlier observations and committed actions reflect the previous scene. Many simulation robustness benchmarks fix external conditions at reset, leaving this temporal challenge underexamined. We introduce LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark of 8,000 paired cases spanning eight types of changes to geometry, observations, appearance, clutter, and paths. Each pair compares task execution with and without a mid-task event, holding the task, initial state, policy seed, and pre-event action sequence fixed. This controlled comparison distinguishes event-associated regressions from failures already present without the change. Across fourteen current VLA, hybrid, and world-action policies, events reduce success by 11.0-25.7 percentage points. Event profiles reveal shared vulnerabilities to geometry and observation changes, while policy-family rankings interleave. Camera controls show that robustness reflects both competence under the changed conditions and the trajectory from which they are encountered; varying query cadence does not eliminate the gap. Together, the paired protocol and temporal diagnostics establish LIBERO-MAX as a reproducible testbed for diagnosing failures under mid-execution changes and measuring progress toward robot policies that remain effective as the world changes.
tldr: This paper introduces LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark with 8,000 paired cases to evaluate robot policies under mid-task changes, revealing that current VLA and world-action policies significantly degrade in success, providing a controlled protocol for diagnosing robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LIBERO-MAX基准，包含8000个配对案例，用于评估机器人策略在任务中途变化时的表现，发现当前VLA和世界动作策略的成功率显著下降，并为诊断鲁棒性提供了受控协议。
summary_zh: 机器人必须在目标移动、视角变化或障碍物出现后继续执行任务，即使其先前的观察和承诺动作反映的是之前的场景。许多仿真鲁棒性基准在重置时固定外部条件，使得这一时间性挑战未被充分研究。我们提出LIBERO-MAX，一个包含8，000个配对案例的基准，涵盖几何、观察、外观、杂乱和路径等八种变化类型。每个配对比较在有和没有任务中途事件的情况下执行任务的表现，同时保持任务、初始状态、策略种子和事件前动作序列固定不变。这种受控比较能够区分与事件相关的性能下降与在无变化情况下已经存在的失败。在十四个当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、混合和世界动作策略中，事件使成功率下降11.0-25.7个百分点。事件特征揭示了在几何和观察变化上的共同弱点，而策略家族的排名相互交错。相机控制表明，鲁棒性既反映了在变化条件下的能力，也反映了遭遇这些变化时所处的轨迹；改变查询节奏并不能消除差距。综上，配对协议和时间诊断使LIBERO-MAX成为一个可复现的测试平台，用于诊断在执行中变化下的失败，并衡量机器人策略在世界变化中保持有效性的进展。

title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
summary: Latent world models rely on representation geometry for planning, yet regularizing the latent marginal alone does not determine the state-to-state relationships used for action selection. We show that this can cause planning-relevant novelty structure to be weakened as representations are transformed into the final latent used by the planner. We introduce Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS), a training objective that explicitly preserves relational geometry while calibrating the global latent distribution. ATLAS transfers normalized pairwise structure from an informative encoder representation to the planning latent and uses Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) to calibrate its marginal through one-dimensional Wasserstein-2 transport. Our analysis shows that relational preservation and marginal calibration impose non-redundant constraints, and connects finite-candidate planning stability to relational distortion, latent-scale mismatch, and prediction error. Instantiated in LeWM, ATLAS improves mean goal-reaching success across PushT, TwoRoom, and OGBench-Cube on both lower- and higher-novelty evaluation subsets, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes. Representation and rollout diagnostics further show stronger novelty-related structure in the planning latent, improved marginal calibration, and lower multi-step prediction error. Together, these results highlight preservation of planning-relevant latent geometry as an important ingredient for reliable world-model planning. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/.
tldr: ATLAS introduces a training objective that preserves relational geometry in latent world models while calibrating the marginal distribution via Wasserstein embedding matching, improving goal-reaching performance and planning stability in simulated environments.
tldr_zh: ATLAS 提出了一种训练目标，在潜在世界模型中保留关系几何并校准边际分布，从而提高了模拟环境中的目标达成性能和规划稳定性。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型依赖于表征几何结构进行规划，然而仅对潜在边际进行正则化并不能确定用于动作选择的态间关系。我们表明，这可能导致当表征被转换为规划器所使用的最终潜在表示时，与规划相关的新颖性结构被削弱。我们引入了潜在结构对齐传输（ATLAS），这是一种训练目标，在校准全局潜在分布的同时显式保留关系几何结构。ATLAS将信息丰富的编码器表征中的归一化成对结构迁移至规划潜在表示，并通过一维Wasserstein-2传输使用Wasserstein嵌入匹配（WEMReg）来校准其边际分布。我们的分析表明，关系保留与边际校准施加了非冗余的约束，并将有限候选规划稳定性与关系失真、潜在尺度失配及预测误差联系起来。在LeWM中实例化后，ATLAS在PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube的低新颖性与高新颖性评估子集上均提升了平均目标达成成功率，其中在高新颖性TwoRoom回合中提升最为显著。表征与轨迹展开诊断进一步显示，规划潜在表示中与新颖性相关的结构更强，边际校准更优，且多步预测误差更低。综合来看，这些结果凸显了保留与规划相关的潜在几何结构作为可靠世界模型规划的重要组成要素。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/ 获取。

title: Bilinear World Models: Learning Representations with Structured Dynamics for Efficient Control
summary: World models jointly learn latent representations and dynamics that predict how high-dimensional observations evolve under actions. In this work, we propose a JEPA-style world model in which, rather than learning arbitrary latent dynamics, we restrict them to follow a bilinear parameterization. This structure enables efficient planning and control while shifting the modeling burden onto the encoder, encouraging richer representations that expose the controllable geometry of the system. In particular, this structured parameterization allows us to structurally enforce action recoverability, thereby preventing representation collapse by construction. Although prescribing a bilinear parametrization may appear restrictive, we show that a broad class of nonlinear dynamical systems admits a transformation under which the dynamics become bilinear. Empirically, we show across standard 2D and 3D control tasks that representations with bilinear-parameterized dynamics can be learned directly from high-dimensional observations, reducing planning time by nearly three orders of magnitude while retaining or even improving control accuracy. We also propose more demanding regimes of longer-horizon planning and real-time control, and demonstrate that our method succeeds in both, moving JEPA-style world models beyond short-horizon offline planning.
tldr: This paper introduces a JEPA-style world model with bilinear latent dynamics, enabling efficient planning and control from high-dimensional observations while preventing representation collapse through action recoverability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有双线性潜在动力学的JEPA风格世界模型，能够从高维观测中进行高效规划和控制，并通过动作可恢复性防止表示崩溃。
summary_zh: 世界模型联合学习潜在表示与动力学，以预测高维观测在动作作用下如何演化。在本工作中，我们提出了一种JEPA风格的世界模型，其中我们并不学习任意的潜在动力学，而是将其限制为遵循双线性参数化形式。这一结构使得高效规划与控制成为可能，同时将建模负担转移至编码器，从而促进更丰富的表示，揭示系统的可控几何结构。特别地，这种结构化参数化使我们能够在结构上保证动作的可恢复性，从而在构造上防止表示坍缩。尽管预设双线性参数化看似具有限制性，但我们证明，一大类非线性动力系统均可通过某种变换转化为双线性动力学形式。在实验中，我们展示了在标准二维和三维控制任务中，具有双线性参数化动力学的表示可以直接从高维观测中学习得到，规划时间减少了近三个数量级，同时保持甚至提升了控制精度。我们还提出了更具挑战性的长时域规划与实时控制场景，并证明我们的方法在这两种场景中均取得成功，从而将JEPA风格的世界模型推广至短时域离线规划之外。

title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
summary: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO.
tldr: This paper introduces ACPPO, a PPO extension for action chunking in reinforcement learning that uses a chunked actor with a standard state-value critic, and ACPPO-Corr which adds a stepwise feedback corrector for closed-loop control within chunks. It demonstrates strong performance across 25 simulated robotic tasks in IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, showing that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when paired with closed-loop correction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ACPPO，一种用于强化学习中动作分块的PPO扩展，使用分块actor和标准状态值critic，并提出了ACPPO-Corr，通过逐步反馈校正器实现块内闭环控制。在IsaacGym和Bi-DexHands的25个模拟机器人任务中展示了强劲性能，表明动作分块与闭环校正结合可在在线PPO中有效。
summary_zh: 动作分块通过在强化学习中选择短动作序列而非单个动作来实现时间抽象，但许多现有方法在高维机器人控制中面临两个局限性。第一，许多方法依赖于基于动作分块的值函数，而随着动作维度和分块长度的增加，这些值函数可能难以学习。第二，开环执行分块会移除分块内的反馈，从而限制了在接触密集任务中的响应能力。我们提出了动作分块PPO（ACPPO），这是一种PPO扩展，采用分块策略网络，同时保留标准的状态值评论家网络，从而避免了分块Q函数。我们进一步提出了ACPPO-Corr，该方法通过逐步骤反馈校正器增强分块规划器，在分块内在线调整规划动作。在来自IsaacGym和Bi-DexHands的25个模拟机器人任务中，涵盖运动、手臂操作和灵巧手-物体交互，ACPPO-Corr在评估方法中取得了最强的综合性能，并在决策频率敏感和决策频率中性任务子集上均表现最佳。消融实验表明，适度的分块长度效果最佳，且校正器正则化对于平衡分块级规划与局部反馈至关重要。这些结果表明，当分块级规划与闭环校正相结合时，动作分块可以在在线PPO中有效发挥作用。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO。

title: Design and Validation of an Antagonistic Tendon-Driven Dexterous Robotic Hand with Bidirectional Operation
summary: Dexterous robotic hands typically reproduce human hand morphology but inherit its one-sided grasping workspace, requiring wrist or arm reorientation to grasp from the opposite side. Existing reversible hands generally rely on non-anthropomorphic, soft, or task-specific finger arrangements, whereas conventional five-digit anthropomorphic hands remain designed primarily for palmar-side grasping. This paper presents an anthropomorphic, human-scale (200 mm length), lightweight (220 g), 3D-printed, 17-DoF robotic hand built on a bidirectional antagonistic tendon-routing mechanism, in which flexion/extension (except the coupled joint) and abduction/adduction at joints are actively driven without passive return springs. The proposed routing mechanism allows all degrees of freedom to cross their neutral configuration and form grasp closures on either the palmar or dorsal side. Experimental evaluation demonstrates an average motor-to-joint transmission error of 3.0%, an average joint transmission bandwidth of 13.2 Hz, a maximum fingertip force of 29 N, and a positioning repeatability up to 0.15 mm. The hand further achieves a Kapandji score of 8, successfully performs all 33 GRASP Taxonomy grasp types, and performs palmar- and dorsal-side grasping tasks, validating bidirectional operation in a compact, human-scale platform.
tldr: This paper presents a 17-DoF anthropomorphic robotic hand with a bidirectional antagonistic tendon mechanism, enabling palmar and dorsal grasping, and validates it through extensive experiments including all 33 GRASP Taxonomy grasps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有双向拮抗肌腱机构的17自由度拟人机器人手，实现手掌侧和手背侧抓取，并通过包括33种GRASP抓取类型在内的实验验证了其性能。
summary_zh: 灵巧机器人手通常复制人类手部形态，但继承了其单侧抓取工作空间，需要腕部或手臂重新定向才能从对侧抓取。现有可翻转手通常依赖非拟人化、软体或任务特定的手指布置，而传统五指拟人化手仍主要设计用于掌侧抓取。本文提出了一种拟人化、人体尺度（200毫米长）、轻量化（220克）、3D打印的17自由度机器人手，其基于双向拮抗肌腱布线机制，关节处的屈曲/伸展（除耦合关节外）和内收/外展均由主动驱动，无需被动复位弹簧。所提出的布线机制允许所有自由度跨越其中立构型，并在掌侧或背侧形成抓取闭合。实验评估表明，平均电机到关节的传动误差为3.0%，平均关节传动带宽为13.2 Hz，最大指尖力为29 N，定位重复精度可达0.15毫米。该手进一步实现了Kapandji评分为8，成功执行了全部33种GRASP分类抓取类型，并完成掌侧和背侧抓取任务，验证了其在紧凑、人体尺度平台上的双向操作能力。

title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
summary: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. Specifically, we construct 42 simulation scenes spanning four scene families and 21 scene types, including 18 urban, 12 natural, six infrastructure, and six disaster scenes. To ensure data quality, 12 annotators spent two months manually annotating 109 landmarks, 2099 target objects, and 2099 object anchors across these scenes. We further construct 205,732 task instances, comprising over 100K semantic-goal and over 100K image-goal instances across Base, Standard, and Long-Horizon settings. Each task instance includes a collision-free reference trajectory and corresponding multi-view video recordings. We also develop a unified evaluation framework with a scene partition comprising 21 in-distribution scenes and 21 out-of-distribution scenes. Finally, our evaluation of five open-source and four closed-source multimodal large language models reveals that there is still a long way to go toward achieving general-purpose aerial agents. All can be found at https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/.
tldr: AerialDojo-200K is a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, providing 205,732 task instances across diverse 3D scenes and a unified evaluation framework, and showing that current multimodal LLMs still lack general-purpose aerial agent capabilities.
tldr_zh: AerialDojo-200K 是一个用于开放世界空中目标搜索的大规模基准套件，提供 205,732 个任务实例和统一的评估框架，并显示当前多模态大模型尚缺乏通用空中智能体的能力。
summary_zh: 开放世界空中物体-目标搜索是一项基础但具有挑战性的任务，要求空中智能体自主探索大规模、非结构化的三维环境，并根据语义描述或参考图像到达目标物体，而非遵循与路线相关的指令。然而，该任务的研究仍处于起步阶段，且依赖规模较小、环境特定的基准，其动作空间和数据格式异构。这些局限性阻碍了大规模训练和跨基准评估，制约了空中智能体的可扩展性和泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AerialDojo-200K，一个面向开放世界空中物体-目标搜索的大规模基准套件，其场景数量是现有最大基准的3倍，任务实例数量是其18.7倍。具体而言，我们构建了42个仿真场景，涵盖四个场景族和21种场景类型，包括18个城市场景、12个自然场景、6个基础设施场景和6个灾害场景。为确保数据质量，12名标注人员花费两个月时间，在这些场景中人工标注了109个地标、2099个目标物体和2099个物体锚点。我们进一步构建了205，732个任务实例，包括超过10万个语义目标实例和超过10万个图像目标实例，涵盖基础（Base）、标准（Standard）和长时程（Long-Horizon）三种设置。每个任务实例包含一条无碰撞参考轨迹及相应的多视角视频记录。我们还开发了一个统一的评估框架，场景划分为21个分布内场景和21个分布外场景。最后，我们对五个开源和四个闭源多模态大语言模型的评估表明，实现通用空中智能体仍有很长的路要走。所有资源可在 https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/ 获取。

title: CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes
summary: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.
tldr: CoDimRecon is an agentic framework that reconstructs simulation-ready 3D scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB images, leveraging category-wise agent sessions for deformable curve/surface/volume representation and simulator-based behavioral tests to refine physics models. It demonstrates robot interactions across rod, shell, and solid simulation assets, including a paper-folding case with plastic bending.
tldr_zh: CoDimRecon 是一个智能体框架，可从多视角 RGB 图像重建包含刚体、铰接体和可变形体的仿真就绪 3D 场景，利用类别智能体会话生成曲线/曲面/体积表示，并通过基于模拟器的行为测试细化物理模型。它在杆、壳和实体模拟资产上展示了机器人交互，包括塑料弯曲的折纸案例。
summary_zh: 从真实世界观测中重建可直接用于仿真的3D场景，为机器人技术、游戏和沉浸式应用提供了支撑，然而现有方法大多假设物体为刚体。这为可变形物体留下了重要空白，因为其可仿真几何取决于维度（曲线、曲面或体积），且其行为可能需要对弹性模型之外的物理模型进行建模。我们提出CoDimRecon，一个代理式框架，可从多视角RGB观测中重建包含刚体、铰接物体和可变形物体的可编辑场景。场景级几何先验为尺度和布局提供基准，而物体级生成网格引导代理获得细节丰富且紧凑的几何结构；铰接刚体被分解为带显式关节的可运动部件。对于可变形物体，按类别划分的代理会话将曲线重建为中心线加半径，将曲面重建为带厚度的流形壳，将体积重建为用于体网格划分的水密实体。可复用的仿真器技能可初始化兼容的物理模型和参数，而代理引导的行为测试可暴露不匹配问题，并触发对运动、几何、数值或材料建模的定向修订。在评估的Replica和ScanNet++场景中，CoDimRecon在实现有竞争力的组合重建精度的同时，还额外生成了用于杆、壳和实体仿真的可变形资产。我们进一步展示了在全部三种表示上的机器人交互，包括一个受控折纸案例，其中行为测试促使了塑性弯曲的实现。

title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
summary: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.
tldr: The paper proposes Dual-WM, a dual-latent world model that separates local execution and long-range planning via distinct state representations and dynamics models, improving long-horizon goal-conditioned visual control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出双潜在世界模型（Dual-WM），通过分离局部执行与长期规划的状态表示和动力学模型，提升长时域目标条件视觉控制的性能。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型尽管在短期预测上表现准确，但在长期规划方面往往面临困难。递归式展开会导致误差累积，而高维潜在空间中的距离集中现象也可能削弱目标区分能力。为此，我们提出了一种双潜在世界模型（Dual-WM），通过不同的状态表示和动力学模型，将局部执行与长程规划分离。低层模型预测动作条件下的状态转移，而高层模型利用学习到的宏动作在更长时间跨度上进行规划。我们还提出了一种基于加权展开的长期表征学习方法（LoRe），在两个层次上对自生成预测进行监督。对递归误差传播的分析促使我们采用指数级时间跨度权重，并为两个时间尺度设置不同的衰减率。在规划过程中，高层模型生成潜在子目标，低层模型将其细化为精确执行所需的动作。我们在五个目标条件化视觉控制任务上，从零开始对Dual-WM进行评估，并与各任务中最强的基线方法（不含演员引导提议）进行比较。在目标偏移量为50和100个环境步时，平均成功率分别从75.9%提升至84.4%，以及从61.4%提升至69.5%。在偏移量为100时，Dual-WM在所有五个任务上均优于这些基线，并相较于LeWM将平均成功率提高了30.8个百分点。消融实验及辅助分析进一步证明，该方法能够为目标评估提供更具信息量的表征，并在递归预测下保持更高的一致性。这些结果凸显了在潜在规划中将时间角色分离并进行多时间跨度训练的重要性。我们的核心实现可在 https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official 获取。

title: Abductive World Modeling via Causal Representation Learning
summary: The central challenge of world modeling is to learn representations that capture how the world evolves. However, existing world models predominantly represent future states without explicitly capturing the latent causes underlying their evolution, limiting their ability to reason about why and how the world changes. To address this limitation, we propose Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures. Specifically, we realize AWM through the Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP), which organizes the inferred world state into three complementary components - Entity, Dynamic, and Relation - capturing what exists, how it changes, and how entities interact, respectively. By jointly reasoning over the current observation and its predicted future, HASP abductively infers these latent factors and integrates them into a structured state representation for downstream reasoning. To the best of our knowledge, AWM is the first framework to introduce abductive state inference into latent-space world modeling for learning structured representations of world dynamics. Experiments across physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with V-JEPA, a state-of-the-art latent-space world model, AWM improves physical prediction AUROC by 10.7%, causal reasoning accuracy by 16.8%, and action Top-1 accuracy by 68.0%.
tldr: This paper introduces Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations for world modeling by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures, and demonstrates improvements over V-JEPA on physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了溯因世界建模（AWM）框架，通过从预测的未来中溯因推断潜在原因，学习结构化因果表示，并在物理预测、因果推理和动作理解任务上相较V-JEPA取得了提升。
summary_zh: 世界建模的核心挑战在于学习能够捕捉世界演变过程的表征。然而，现有的世界模型主要表征未来状态，并未显式地捕捉驱动其演变的潜在原因，从而限制了模型对世界变化原因和方式的推理能力。为应对这一局限，我们提出溯因世界建模（AWM），这是一个通过从预测的未来中溯因推断潜在原因来学习结构化因果表征的框架。具体而言，我们通过层级溯因状态金字塔（HASP）实现AWM，该金字塔将推断所得的世界状态组织为三个互补的组成部分——实体、动态和关系——分别捕捉存在什么、如何变化以及实体之间如何交互。通过联合推理当前观测及其预测未来，HASP溯因推断这些潜在因素，并将其整合为结构化的状态表征，用于下游推理。据我们所知，AWM是首个将溯因状态推断引入潜空间世界建模以学习世界动态结构化表征的框架。在物理预测、因果推理和行为理解方面的实验验证了我们方法的有效性。与当前最先进的潜空间世界模型V-JEPA相比，AWM在物理预测AUROC上提升了10.7%，因果推理准确率提升了16.8%，行为Top-1准确率提升了68.0%。

title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.
tldr: The paper studies how to select the latent interface layers in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, finding that single-layer selection often outperforms multi-layer fusion and proposing an Information-Noise-Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) based proxy to select layers with much less compute.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型中潜在接口层的选择问题，发现单层选择通常优于多层融合，并提出基于InfoNCE的代理指标来以更少计算量选择层。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过潜在接口将预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络与动作头连接起来，但该接口应暴露哪些骨干网络层仍不明确。我们针对三个预训练模型和两个操作基准（LIBERO和CALVIN），在每种配置下使用三个策略训练种子，研究了冻结骨干网络的单层选择与多层融合。在三种融合机制和三种层子集策略下，54种配置中有47种表现逊于观察到的最优单层策略。我们的统计分析进一步证实，融合的优势非常有限。然而，最佳层在不同骨干网络和基准之间差异显著，这使得层选择至关重要，而穷举式策略扫描成本高昂。我们进一步推导了所提出的针对动作条件InfoNCE和动作预测的信息瓶颈目标之间的重加权等价性，从而将InfoNCE作为层质量的代理指标。在评估的四种代理指标中，经验结果表明InfoNCE与策略成功率的一致性正相关最为稳定。选择InfoNCE得分最高的层所需的GPU计算量比穷举式策略扫描少9至33倍，并将六个设置中的平均选择遗憾从最深层选择的17.89个百分点降低至3.71个百分点。其平均遗憾接近利用全部六个真实扫描事后优化的固定层启发式方法所达到的3.28至3.50个百分点，且在选择过程中无需闭环评估。

title: Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding
summary: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA
tldr: Exemplar2VQA introduces a multi-agent coding framework that generates large-scale 3D spatial question-answer datasets in simulated environments, using deterministic geometric utilities to overcome LLM spatial reasoning limitations, and demonstrates improved MLLM performance on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Exemplar2VQA 提出了一种通过多智能体编码在模拟环境中生成大规模3D空间问答数据集的框架，利用确定性几何工具克服LLM空间推理缺陷，并在多个基准上提升了MLLM的性能。
summary_zh: 推进多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的空间智能发展，受限于复杂、可扩展的三维问答（QA）数据的稀缺。尽管人工标注劳动密集，直接利用LLMs合成这些QA对往往因其在空间与几何计算方面的固有缺陷而失败。我们提出Exemplar2VQA，一种可扩展的基于范例驱动的视觉问答生成框架，通过多智能体编码在模拟环境中快速合成大规模空间QA对。通过为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，Exemplar2VQA通过确定性代码执行绕过了LLMs的空间推理缺陷。至关重要的是，该框架展现出卓越的通用性：以多样化的静态对象中心空间查询模板作为范例，它能无缝且自主地将它们扩展为大规模、高保真的合成数据集。仅使用Exemplar2VQA生成的合成室内数据对Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B）进行微调，即可在多个多样化基准测试中带来显著的性能提升。此外，其有效性不仅局限于室内领域数据集，还能稳健地扩展到室外及混合场景基准测试。这些结果确立了Exemplar2VQA作为一种可扩展且强大的范式，用于弥合具身AI中的仿真到现实鸿沟。我们的代码位于https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

title: Multi-Granularity Language-Guided Imitation Learning via Instruction Decomposition
summary: Using language instructions as conditions to guide robot policy learning has recently become an important research domain. However, existing language-guided policy learning methods typically use an overall task description to guide the entire demonstration trajectory. For manipulation tasks involving multiple execution stages, these methods assign the same language description to different subtasks, making it difficult to distinguish the behaviors required at different stages. In this work, we propose a multi-granularity language guidance method based on instruction decomposition. The proposed method decomposes an overall task description into more fine-grained, concrete subtask-level language instructions, thereby enhancing learning efficiency and improving performance. We evaluate the proposed method in the setting of multi-task imitation learning and validate its effectiveness.
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-granularity language-guided imitation learning method that decomposes task-level instructions into subtask-level instructions to improve multi-task policy learning for manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种多粒度语言引导的模仿学习方法，通过将任务级指令分解为子任务级指令，以提高多任务操作策略的学习效率和性能。
summary_zh: 以语言指令作为条件来引导机器人策略学习，近年来已成为一个重要的研究领域。然而，现有的语言引导策略学习方法通常使用整体任务描述来引导整个示范轨迹。对于涉及多个执行阶段的操作任务，这些方法将相同的语言描述分配给不同的子任务，难以区分不同阶段所需的行为。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于指令分解的多粒度语言引导方法。该方法将整体任务描述分解为更细粒度、更具体的子任务级语言指令，从而提升学习效率并改善性能。我们在多任务模仿学习场景下对所提方法进行了评估，并验证了其有效性。

title: World2Motion: Turning Video World Models into 3D Human Motion Generators
summary: We present World2Motion, a framework that generates scene-aware 3D human motion and corresponding video from a single image and a text prompt. While existing 3D motion generators learn from motion datasets, their generalization is constrained by limited coverage of environments. In contrast, video world models such as Cosmos 3 offer broader environmental priors but are not designed for full-body motion generation; recovering motion from their generated videos requires costly two-stage inference. To address these, we turn Cosmos 3 into a single-stage 3D motion generator. This adaptation has two challenges: the scarcity of paired video--motion data and temporal instability in the generated motion. First, we construct a training dataset combining synthetic video--motion pairs with real videos paired with estimated 3D motion. Second, we propose a shift-decoupled noise schedule that assigns different noise levels to video and motion through shared denoising progress. This design accommodates the different denoising requirements of the two modalities, reducing motion jitter. Experiments on a multi-source interaction benchmark show that World2Motion has better motion--text alignment and scene interaction compared with the evaluated 3D motion generators. It also matches the interaction success rate of the two-stage baseline while achieving approximately 3.3$\times$ faster inference. Our project page is available at https://fyantu.github.io/World2Motion/.
tldr: World2Motion turns a video world model into a single-stage 3D human motion generator, producing scene-aware motion and video from a single image and text prompt with faster inference than two-stage baselines.
tldr_zh: World2Motion 将视频世界模型转化为单阶段 3D 人体动作生成器，从单张图像和文本提示生成场景感知的动作和视频，推理速度比两阶段基线快约 3.3 倍。
summary_zh: 我们提出了World2Motion，一个从单张图像和文本提示生成场景感知的三维人体运动及对应视频的框架。现有三维运动生成器从运动数据集中学习，但其泛化能力受限于环境覆盖范围不足。相比之下，视频世界模型（如Cosmos 3）提供了更广泛的环境先验，但并非为全身运动生成而设计；从生成视频中恢复运动需要昂贵的两阶段推理流程。为解决上述问题，我们将Cosmos 3转化为单阶段三维运动生成器。这一改造面临两个挑战：视频-运动配对数据的稀缺以及生成运动的时间不稳定。首先，我们构建了一个训练数据集，将合成的视频-运动配对与配对估计三维运动的真实视频相结合。其次，我们提出了一种位移解耦噪声调度方法，通过共享去噪进程为视频和运动分配不同的噪声水平。该设计适应了两种模态不同的去噪需求，减少了运动抖动。在多源交互基准上的实验表明，与所评估的三维运动生成器相比，World2Motion在运动-文本对齐和场景交互方面表现更优。同时，其交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，而推理速度提升约3.3倍。我们的项目页面可在https://fyantu.github.io/World2Motion/获取。

title: S4VY: Segment Anything in Feed-Forward 4D Visual Geometry
summary: Accurate instance segmentation in dynamic scenes is important for downstream applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Existing Segment Anything models operate primarily on 2D image or video masks and preserve identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation built upon feed-forward visual geometry remains underexplored. We introduce S4VY, a Segment Anything model built on feed-forward 4D visual geometry. From a set of RGB observations, S4VY transforms shared visual-geometric features into an exhaustive set of class-agnostic 4D instance masks through a space-time query decoder, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations. This representation supports prompt-independent segmentation as well as point- and box- conditioned selection, without requiring a seed mask or temporal ordering. We further develop an agentic harness for natural-language grounding in the large observation space of a 4D scene. Active tree search identifies relevant frames without scanning every fixed window; a dual-stream grounder combines fine-grained VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features through complementary bounding-box prediction and object-query matching; and an independent critic selects the final 4D instance mask from their predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under a unified evaluation spanning static and dynamic scenes.
tldr: S4VY is a Segment Anything model for feed-forward 4D scene understanding, enabling prompt-independent and point/box/language-conditioned instance segmentation across space-time, targeting robotics and autonomous driving applications.
tldr_zh: S4VY 是一种基于前馈 4D 视觉几何的 SAM 模型，支持无提示以及点/框/语言条件化的时空实例分割，面向机器人和自动驾驶应用。
summary_zh: 动态场景中的精确实例分割对于机器人和自动驾驶等下游应用至关重要。现有的Segment Anything模型主要基于2D图像或视频掩码进行操作，并通过顺序记忆保持身份信息，而基于前馈视觉几何构建的可提示4D实例分割仍待深入探索。我们提出了S4VY，一种建立在前馈4D视觉几何基础上的Segment Anything模型。从一组RGB观测中，S4VY通过时空查询解码器将共享的视觉几何特征转换为一组全面的、与类别无关的4D实例掩码，其中每个持久对象查询在所有观测中绑定一个实体。这种表示支持无提示的分割以及基于点和框条件的选择，无需种子掩码或时间排序。我们还开发了一个智能代理框架，用于在4D场景的大观测空间中进行自然语言接地。主动树搜索无需扫描每个固定窗口即可识别相关帧；双流接地器通过互补的边界框预测和对象查询匹配，将细粒度的VLM视觉先验与几何一致的实例特征相结合；独立的评审器从这些预测中选择最终的4D实例掩码。大量实验表明，在涵盖静态和动态场景的统一评估下，该方法在4D实例分割和语言引导接地性能方面均达到了最先进水平。

title: MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model
summary: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.
tldr: MeteoVerse is a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single image, explicitly modeling weather transitions for preservation, introduction, or removal, with fine-grained intensity control and a new 50K-clip dataset.
tldr_zh: MeteoVerse 是一个统一的天气可控视频世界模型，从单张图像生成未来视频，显式建模天气转换（保持、引入或去除），并支持细粒度强度控制及一个新的 50K 片段数据集。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型旨在根据观察到的场景，在遵循指定相机运动的同时预测未来内容。真实世界的场景演变不仅取决于视点变化和物体动态，还取决于天气等环境条件，这些条件可能显著改变场景外观和可见性。对此类真实天气演变进行建模颇具挑战性，因为所需的天气修改同时依赖于观察到的天气状态和期望的天气状态。根据它们之间的关系，模型可能需要保留、引入或移除某种天气效果。现有视频世界模型通常隐式处理这种天气转换，迫使生成主干网络将天气演变与场景动态和相机运动一同推断，从而导致天气控制不够精确。为解决这一局限，我们提出了MeteoVerse，一个统一的天气可控视频世界模型，可从单张晴天或恶劣天气图像生成未来视频，并以无天气场景描述、目标天气指令和相机轨迹为条件。MeteoVerse不仅以期望天气为条件，还显式估计观察到的天气状态和目标天气状态，并表征所需的天气转换。随后，一个转换感知的天气专家混合模块将该转换转化为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一了天气的保留、引入和移除，同时实现对引入天气强度的细粒度控制。我们进一步构建了MeteoVerse数据集，包含超过5万段真实天气视频片段、生成的晴天对应片段、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注以及相机轨迹。大量实验表明，该方法在保持具有竞争力的场景一致性和相机控制性能的同时，显著提升了天气可控性。

title: Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models
summary: Video world models are largely regarded as predictive models of the physical world and are therefore expected to anticipate the consequences of observed events. However, evaluation has mainly focused on reference similarity, physical-law consistency, or judgment plausibility, estimating anticipation only indirectly. We address this directly: when a release or impact has just occurred but its consequence is withheld, can a world model anticipate what should happen next? We introduce an event-anchored evaluation based on 62 controlled real-world free-fall recordings and 124 clips spanning three object types, with fine-grained release and impact annotations and ground-truth trajectories. The protocol separates consequence production, temporal placement, and physical realization. Across six contemporary video generation and world models, Runway and Veo produce release and subsequent impact events at rates above 93% but often initiate them substantially late, whereas Cosmos-Predict-2.5 and MAGI-1 frequently preserve the pre-event state and produce little or no measurable consequence. Among measurable falls, plausible timing does not necessarily imply physically consistent motion. We further conduct a 15-participant, 20-condition human study in which participants describe the expected consequence from a single event-anchored frame and draw its trajectory. Human predictions favor the recorded future in aggregate while revealing genuine ambiguity among plausible continuations. Overall, physical foresight emerges as a sequence of distinct challenges: initiating a consequence, anchoring it in time, and realizing its motion.
tldr: This paper introduces an event-anchored evaluation protocol for video world models, testing their ability to predict physical consequences (e.g., free-fall) from real-world recordings, and finds that current models often fail to initiate or accurately realize consequences.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于事件锚定的视频世界模型评估协议，测试模型从真实世界记录中预测物理后果（如自由落体）的能力，发现现有模型常常无法启动或准确实现后果。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型在很大程度上被视为物理世界的预测模型，因此预期它们能够预判所观察事件的结果。然而，现有评估主要侧重于参考相似性、物理定律一致性或判断合理性，对预判能力的估计仅是间接的。我们直接针对这一问题展开研究：当一次释放或撞击事件刚刚发生但其后果被隐匿时，世界模型能否预判接下来应当发生什么？我们引入了一种基于事件的评估方法，采用62段受控的真实世界自由落体录像及124段涵盖三种物体类型的视频片段，并配有细粒度的释放与撞击标注及地面真实轨迹。该评估方案将后果生成、时间定位与物理实现三者分离。在六种当代视频生成模型与世界模型中，Runway和Veo生成释放及后续撞击事件的比率超过93%，但往往显著延迟启动这些事件；而Cosmos-Predict-2.5和MAGI-1则频繁保留事件前状态，产生的可测后果极少甚至为零。在可测的坠落事件中，看似合理的时间节点并不必然意味着物理上一致的运动。我们进一步开展了一项包含15名受试者、20种条件的人类研究，参与者需根据单张事件锚定帧描述预期后果并绘制其轨迹。人类预测在总体上倾向于已记录的未来，同时也揭示了合理延续之间真实存在的不确定性。总体而言，物理前瞻能力表现为一系列截然不同的挑战：启动后果、在时间上锚定后果，以及实现其运动。

title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
summary: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.
tldr: This paper introduces RolloutFaith, a framework for auditing persistent internal interventions in visual world models, showing that fitted editors yield limited long-term effects while reference intervention (activation patching) offers more sustained gains, and proposing Delayed LoReFT to improve lasting intervention by optimizing through future transitions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 RolloutFaith 框架，用于审计视觉世界模型中持续的内部干预，发现拟合编辑器长期效果有限，而参考干预（激活修补）提供更持续的改进，并提出 Delayed LoReFT 通过未来过渡优化以改善持久干预效果。
summary_zh: 可解释性方法（如探针、激活补丁和学习型编辑器）旨在揭示或修改模型当前的运算过程。世界模型则提出了更高的要求：由于其预测结果会成为后续预测的输入，因此有效的内部修正必须在编辑停止后仍然持续生效。为此，我们提出了RolloutFaith框架，该框架在固定事件、动作、噪声和信息预算条件下，同时衡量干预时刻所产生预测的语义改进，以及其后自主预测中的语义改进。我们分别在Crafter、Cartpole和CoinRun上，对三个世界模型中的十个拟合编辑器进行了评估。我们还使用了参考激活补丁（Reference Activation Patching），即用从真实观测中计算得到的配对激活替换模型激活，以衡量所选接口上可用的修正效果。该参考干预在所有九种模型与任务组合中均改进后续预测，并在其中八种组合中优于最佳拟合编辑器；然而，在九种组合中的五种里，其持续增益随预测视界延长而下降。当前拟合编辑器仅能获得有限且不一致的长期效果。通过将各个状态分量恢复到其未受干扰的值，我们发现持久效果在DIAMOND中经由最新生成的帧传播，在DreamerV3中经由循环记忆传播，而在STORM中则经由两者共同传播。这些发现表明，训练应奖励未来后果。为验证这一假设，我们提出了延迟LoReFT（Delayed LoReFT），该方法通过四个冻结的未来转移对相同的低秩干预进行优化，并一定程度上提升了干预的持续效果。

title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
summary: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbors. For both classes, we establish feasibility conditions and finite-horizon convergence guarantees. We further derive a Wasserstein bound that characterizes the distributional deviation induced by the guidance. We demonstrate DeGG-Flow on multi-robot collaboration for crossing a spatial gap by reconfiguring the environment, and on multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements. Across both applications, DeGG-Flow directly generates objects that satisfy all corresponding hard requirements, including at team sizes unseen during training.
tldr: The paper introduces DeGG-Flow, a multi-agent flow matching framework with decoupled generative guidance that generates objects satisfying hard constraints, demonstrated on multi-robot collaboration and multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了DeGG-Flow，一种具有解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配框架，可生成满足硬约束的对象，并在多机器人协作和多对象场景生成中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 生成式建模被广泛用于从复杂的多模态分布中生成多样化对象。然而，其表达能力通常并不伴随正式保证，即生成对象满足硬约束或要求。在多智能体生成中，这一问题变得更加具有挑战性，因为硬性要求可能依赖于多个智能体，而每个智能体可能需要在不依赖其他智能体同时计算的引导输入的情况下，自行确定其引导输入。为此，我们提出了DeGG-Flow，一个用于多智能体流匹配的解耦生成引导通用框架。通过将生成过程表示为控制仿射动力学系统，我们针对两类耦合要求开发了引导条件：共享要求，其满足依赖于多个智能体共同作用；以及私有要求，与每个个体智能体相关，并依赖于其邻居。对于这两类要求，我们建立了可行性条件和有限时域收敛保证。我们进一步推导了一个Wasserstein界，用以刻画由引导引起的分布偏差。我们在多机器人协作跨越空间间隙并通过重构环境实现任务，以及带有可供性要求的多对象场景生成中，展示了DeGG-Flow的有效性。在这两个应用中，DeGG-Flow直接生成满足所有相应硬性要求的对象，即使在训练中未见过的团队规模下也是如此。

title: Semantic Map Sharing and Capability-Aware Coverage Planning for AI-Native 6G Robotic Coordination
summary: Search and Rescue (SAR) operations increasingly deploy heterogeneous teams of aerial and ground robots. However, conventional coverage methods typically do not translate perceived terrain into platform-specific reachability, while continuous image exchange imposes a high communication cost. We propose an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework that integrates aerial terrain perception, robot-specific traversability reasoning, and payload-efficient semantic state sharing. Aerial observations are converted into compact semantic grid maps, enabling reachability-constrained area decomposition and capability-aware coverage paths that assign only regions admitted by each robot's capability profile. The resulting perception-sharing-planning loop feeds semantic corrections into traversability reasoning and replanning, forming an application-level mechanism motivated by AI-enabled goal-oriented communication envisioned for AI-native 6G networks. For the high-update case, transmitting semantic corrections reduces the application payload by a factor of approximately $82$ relative to periodic full-map sharing. Across matched benchmark scenarios, the proposed method achieved $91.5\%$ coverage with no capability-infeasible allocations, compared with $78.8\%$ coverage and a $21.5\%$ capability-infeasible allocation rate for LS-MCPP. Semantic corrections update the shared planning state without requiring repeated transmission of the complete map.
tldr: This paper presents an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework for heterogeneous aerial-ground robot teams in search and rescue, which converts aerial observations into compact semantic maps for robot-specific traversability reasoning and capability-aware path planning. It drastically reduces communication payload via semantic corrections and achieves 91.5% coverage with no infeasible allocations in benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向搜救任务的异构空地机器人边缘中心语义感知覆盖规划框架，通过将航空观测转换为紧凑的语义地图，实现机器人专属可通过性推理和能力感知路径规划，并利用语义修正将通信负载降低约82倍，在基准测试中实现91.5%的覆盖率且无不合理分配。
summary_zh: 搜救（SAR）任务日益采用由空中和地面机器人组成的异构团队。然而，传统覆盖方法通常不会将感知到的地形转化为特定平台的可达性，而连续图像交换则会带来较高的通信成本。我们提出了一种以边缘为中心、语义感知的覆盖规划框架，该框架整合了空中地形感知、机器人特定可通过性推理以及负载高效的语义状态共享。空中观测被转换为紧凑的语义栅格地图，从而支持受可达性约束的区域分解和具备能力感知的覆盖路径规划，仅分配各机器人能力档案所允许的区域。由此形成的感知-共享-规划闭环将语义修正反馈至可通过性推理与重规划中，构建了一种应用级机制，其动机源自面向人工智能原生6G网络所设想的、由AI驱动的目标导向通信。在高更新频率场景下，相较于周期性全地图共享，传输语义修正可使应用负载减少约82倍。在匹配的基准测试场景中，所提方法实现了91.5%的覆盖率且无能力不可行分配，而LS-MCPP的覆盖率为78.8%，且能力不可行分配率为21.5%。语义修正仅更新共享规划状态，无需重复传输完整地图。

title: Cascaded consensus splitting for multi-branch contingency games
summary: Contingency games enable agents to anticipate and plan for other agents' hypothetical intents by constructing trajectories with a shared prefix and intent-dependent branches. While contingency games capture intent uncertainty, existing formulations rely on a single branching time, oversimplifying interactions in which different agents' intentions are revealed at different times. Moreover, the computational cost of such problems grows rapidly with the number of agents and intents, as all scenario-dependent best responses must be solved jointly. We introduce a multi-branch contingency architecture in which sources of intent uncertainty can be resolved progressively at different branching times, allowing the planned trajectories to adapt to the asynchronous revelation of intents. We also develop an ADMM-based solver that exploits scenario-level parallelism. Experiments on tightly coupled three-agent interactions support that the proposed architecture outperforms the conventional single-branch while achieving a lower mean receding-horizon solve time.
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-branch contingency game architecture with asynchronous branching times for intent uncertainty, along with an ADMM-based solver. Experiments on tightly coupled three-agent interactions show improved performance and lower solve time compared to single-branch approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有异步分支时间的多分支应急博弈架构，并开发了基于ADMM的求解器。在紧密耦合的三智能体交互实验中，该方法相比单分支方法性能更优且求解时间更短。
summary_zh: 偶然性博弈使智能体能够通过构建具有共享前缀和意图依赖分支的轨迹，来预测并规划其他智能体的假设性意图。尽管偶然性博弈能够捕捉意图不确定性，但现有公式依赖于单一分支时间，这过度简化了不同智能体意图在不同时间点被揭示的交互过程。此外，此类问题的计算成本会随着智能体和意图数量的增加而迅速增长，因为所有依赖于场景的最优响应必须联合求解。我们引入了一种多分支偶然性架构，其中意图不确定性的来源可以在不同分支时间点逐步被解析，从而使规划轨迹能够适应意图的异步揭示。我们还开发了一种基于ADMM的求解器，利用场景级并行性。在紧密耦合的三智能体交互实验表明，所提出的架构优于传统单分支架构，同时实现了更低的平均滚动时域求解时间。

title: When to Adapt: Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection for Efficient Training-Free Adaptation in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment. Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware. To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation in open-vocabulary segmentation, aiming to reduce unnecessary adaptations for long-term robotic deployments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于开放词汇分割中免训练连续测试时适应的多信号域偏移检测方法，旨在减少长期机器人部署中不必要的适应。
summary_zh: 稳健且可靠的感知能力对于在真实环境中运行的自主机器人至关重要，尤其是在环境条件可能随时间显著变化的长期任务中。尽管视觉基础模型（VFM）的最新进展提升了开放词汇语义分割的性能，但这些模型仍可能受到域偏移的影响，若未能适应当前环境，其性能将显著下降。免训练域自适应是一种相关的自适应范式，其核心在于通过轻量级适配器在线调整模型。近期方法多采用逐帧处理的方式，这对于资源受限的机器人硬件部署而言并不实际。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于开放词汇分割中免训练连续测试时自适应（TF-CTTA）的多信号域偏移检测方法。该方法利用连续帧之间的时间一致性，通过监测并综合域偏移的互补方面（视觉变化、适配器失配和语义漂移）来仅在必要时触发自适应。我们在包含室内与室外环境的基准测试以及真实机器人数据上验证了所提方法。实验结果表明，该方法在保持分割精度的同时显著减少了自适应次数，从而使免训练自适应在长期真实世界机器人部署中变得切实可行。

title: RoboFin3D: A Sim-to-Real Platform for Robotic Surface Finishing
summary: Grinding and sanding are fundamental processes in industrial robotic surface finishing. However, physical trials are expensive and consume workpieces, making reproducible experiments difficult. We present RoboFin3D, a sim-to-real platform built on Isaac Sim and the Newton physics engine, that provides physics-based grinding and sanding simulation for cheap and repeatable robotic surface finishing experiments. RoboFin3D utilizes a signed distance field (SDF) to model the changing geometry of the workpiece, enabling contact computation, live updates and rendering without an intermediate mesh. It additionally uses a separate surface field to model progressive surface appearance change during sanding. We also introduce WeldGen, a weld sampling module, to generate weld beads on 8,918 real-world workpiece meshes for providing diverse simulation assets. The simulation parameters are calibrated on real experimental results and our evaluation demonstrates our simulation's fidelity against the real world. We also demonstrate that simulation-generated data can be used to improve the performance of perception models. Simulation-only fine-tuning of SAM2 improves IoU for segmentation of unsanded regions from 77.15% to 84.47%, while combined synthetic and real training reaches 97.41%.
tldr: RoboFin3D is a sim-to-real platform for robotic surface finishing built on Isaac Sim, using SDF for geometry and a surface field for appearance, plus WeldGen for generating weld assets; it shows sim-to-real transfer by improving SAM2 segmentation of unsanded regions.
tldr_zh: RoboFin3D 是一个基于 Isaac Sim 的机器人表面处理仿真到现实平台，利用 SDF 建模几何和表面场模拟外观变化，并通过 WeldGen 生成焊缝资产；仿真数据微调 SAM2 可提升未打磨区域分割的 IoU。
summary_zh: 磨削和砂光是工业机器人表面精加工中的基础工序。然而，物理试验成本高昂且消耗工件，使得可重复实验难以实现。我们提出RoboFin3D，一个基于Isaac Sim和Newton物理引擎的仿真到现实平台，为低成本、可重复的机器人表面精加工实验提供基于物理的磨削和砂光仿真。RoboFin3D利用符号距离场（SDF）对工件变化中的几何形状进行建模，无需中间网格即可实现接触计算、实时更新和渲染。此外，它还使用独立的表面场来模拟砂光过程中表面外观的渐进变化。我们还引入了WeldGen，一个焊缝采样模块，在8,918个真实工件网格上生成焊缝，以提供多样化的仿真资产。仿真参数根据真实实验结果进行校准，我们的评估证明了仿真相对于现实世界的保真度。我们还展示了仿真生成的数据可用于提升感知模型的性能。仅使用仿真数据对SAM2进行微调，即可将未砂光区域分割的IoU从77.15%提升至84.47%，而结合合成数据与真实数据训练则可达到97.41%。

title: Adversarially Robust Geometric Safety Certificates for Nonholonomic Robots Against Maneuvering Obstacles
summary: Safe navigation against obstacles that can actively maneuver within bounded capabilities remains challenging: robust control barrier function methods typically treat obstacle actions as generic disturbances, while differential-game approaches are computationally expensive for online navigation. We propose an adversarially robust geometric certificate that accounts for the worst-case effect of admissible obstacle maneuvers directly in the safe-set geometry through a closed-form contraction of the certificate parameters. The construction exploits a structural property of line-of-sight (LoS) certificates: the robot and obstacle actions enter the certificate through a common state-dependent geometric gain. This gain cancels in the worst-case comparison, reducing the differential game to a direct comparison between obstacle maneuvering capability and the weaker of the robot's longitudinal and steering authorities. Instantiated on the parabolic certificate, the construction yields Adversarially Robust Dynamic Parabolic Control Barrier Functions (AR-DPCBF), for which we establish sufficient conditions for forward invariance of the contracted safe set against all admissible obstacle maneuvers under kinematic bicycle dynamics with bounded inputs. When the obstacle capability is unknown, a sliding-window estimator supplies a high-probability upper bound, allowing the guarantee to be retained with the corresponding coverage probability. We further formulate soft and buffered variants to recover feasibility in dense environments. Simulations across obstacle capabilities, densities, and capability mismatch show substantial reductions in barrier violations and collisions and demonstrate that pointwise robustification of the barrier derivative cannot substitute for contraction of its geometry.
tldr: This paper introduces adversarially robust geometric safety certificates for nonholonomic robots, using control barrier functions with contracted safe sets to guarantee safety against maneuvering obstacles, validated in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文针对非完整机器人提出对抗鲁棒的几何安全证书，通过收缩安全集的控制屏障函数保证对机动障碍的安全性，并在仿真中验证。
summary_zh: 针对具备有界机动能力的主动障碍物的安全导航仍具挑战性：鲁棒控制屏障函数方法通常将障碍物行为视为一般扰动，而微分博弈方法在在线导航中计算成本过高。我们提出一种对抗鲁棒几何证书，通过在证书参数的闭式收缩中，直接在安全集几何中考虑可容许障碍物机动的最坏情况影响。该构造利用了视线（LoS）证书的一个结构性性质：机器人和障碍物的作用通过一个共同的、依赖于状态的几何增益进入证书。该增益在最坏情况比较中相互抵消，从而将微分博弈简化为障碍物机动能力与机器人纵向及转向权限中较弱者之间的直接比较。将该构造应用于抛物线证书，我们得到对抗鲁棒动态抛物线控制屏障函数（AR-DPCBF），并建立了在运动学自行车模型及有界输入下，收缩安全集对所有可容许障碍物机动保持前向不变性的充分条件。当障碍物能力未知时，滑动窗口估计器提供高概率上界，使保证得以以相应的覆盖概率保留。我们进一步提出软性及缓冲变体，以在密集环境中恢复可行性。跨障碍物能力、密度及能力失配的仿真结果表明，屏障违规和碰撞显著减少，并证明屏障导数的逐点鲁棒化不能替代其几何收缩。

title: Multifunctional Locomotion Control of Multi-Jointed BURs with Swimming and gait Capabilities
summary: Multimodal biomimetic underwater robots (BURs) can conduct underwater tasks suitable for the environment. Combining the characteristics of aquatic organisms enables the swimming and leggedlocomotion required for underwater exploration. Locomotion control mechanism relies on rule-based behavior selection and the designer's discretion. This limits the robot's ability to acquire new behavioral capabilities to the predetermined range of behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a mechanism and control system that enables the expression of multimodal locomotion capabilities from the same multi-jointed structure. A mechanism equipped with four leg-fins each having four axes is used. This controller achieves nonlinear behavior based on sensor modalities, rather than relying on predefined conditional rule-based on locomotion functions. This system was validated through both physical and simulation testing based on multiple sensor data and behavioral patterns. Utilizing a potential function in multimodal locomotion control was verified to enable transitions between two or three behaviors. Implementing the control method as a multimodal controller is expected to enhance its application in underwater exploration. Our project page is at https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/.
tldr: This paper proposes a mechanism and control system for multimodal biomimetic underwater robots (BURs) with multi-jointed leg-fins, enabling swimming and legged locomotion via sensor-based nonlinear control and potential functions, validated in physics and simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于多关节仿生水下机器人的机构和控制系统，通过基于传感器的非线性控制和势函数实现游泳和腿式运动的多种运动模式，并在物理和仿真中验证。
summary_zh: 多模态仿生水下机器人（BURs）能够执行适应环境的水下任务。结合水生生物的特性，使其具备水下探索所需的游动与步行运动能力。其运动控制机制依赖于基于规则的行为选择及设计者的判断，这限制了机器人获取新行为能力的范围，使其局限于预设行为集之内。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了一种机构与控制系统，能够从同一多关节结构中表达多模态运动能力。该系统采用了一种配备四个腿鳍、每个腿鳍具有四个轴的机构。该控制器基于传感器模态实现非线性行为，而非依赖预定义的基于运动功能的规则条件。通过基于多种传感器数据和行为模式的物理实验与仿真测试，该系统得到了验证。利用势函数进行多模态运动控制，已被证实能够实现两种或三种行为之间的转换。将该控制方法实现为多模态控制器，有望增强其在水下探索中的应用。我们的项目主页为：https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/。

title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Flow-driven Multi-Anchor Exploration for Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping
summary: To advance the development of embodied intelligence, Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping has attracted increasing attention, aiming to perform a long-horizon and shortest trajectory exploration for reconstructing unseen scenarios. Since only limited information about unseen environments is available, methods built on the closed-set assumption, i.e., assuming that the test environments are similar to those seen during training, cannot generalize satisfactorily. In existing active mapping methods, long-horizon exploration is often guided by predicting a coarse long-range goal and then converting it into an executable path. However, this stage is usually formulated as single-point prediction. Under partial observability, the same local observation may correspond to multiple plausible exploration directions, making such deterministic prediction prone to brittle decisions and degraded performance in unseen scenarios. Our experiments further verify that this is a key factor underlying their weak generalization. To address this issue, we reformulate long-horizon target prediction as conditional multimodal anchor generation using Conditional Flow Matching.Instead of predicting a single goal, our method learns a conditional distribution over coarse exploration anchors from the current mapping state. These anchors are first converted into executable candidate paths through obstacle-aware planning. We then apply exploration-mode clustering to compress geometrically similar trajectories and reduce candidate redundancy. Finally, a hierarchical selection module selects the most promising mode and reranks paths within it to produce the final executable trajectory. Experiments show that our method improves generalization and reconstruction efficiency in open environments.
tldr: This paper proposes a flow-driven multi-anchor exploration method for open-environment active 3D mapping, reformulating long-horizon target prediction as conditional multimodal anchor generation using Conditional Flow Matching, and selecting the best path via clustering and hierarchical selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于开放环境主动三维建图的流驱动多锚点探索方法，将长时程目标预测重新表述为基于条件流匹配的条件多模态锚点生成，并通过聚类和分层选择来选择最佳路径。
summary_zh: 为了推动具身智能的发展，开放环境下的主动三维建图日益受到关注，其目标是通过长时程、最短轨迹的探索来重建未知场景。由于对未知环境仅有有限信息可用，基于封闭集假设（即假设测试环境与训练环境相似）的方法难以实现令人满意的泛化性能。在现有的主动建图方法中，长时程探索通常通过先预测一个粗糙的远距离目标，再将其转化为可执行路径来实现。然而，这一阶段通常被建模为单点预测。在部分可观测条件下，相同的局部观测可能对应多个合理的探索方向，使得这种确定性预测容易产生脆弱的决策，并在未知场景中性能下降。我们的实验进一步验证了这是其泛化能力较弱的关键因素。为解决这一问题，我们将长时程目标预测重新表述为基于条件流匹配的条件多模态锚点生成。我们的方法不是预测单一目标，而是从当前建图状态中学习粗粒度探索锚点的条件分布。这些锚点首先通过考虑障碍物的规划转化为可执行的候选路径。随后，我们应用探索模式聚类来压缩几何上相似的轨迹并减少候选冗余。最后，一个分层选择模块选出最有前景的模式，并在该模式内对路径进行重新排序，以生成最终的可执行轨迹。实验表明，我们的方法在开放环境中提升了泛化能力和重建效率。

title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
summary: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.
tldr: PReFlow introduces a proposal-conditioned refinement flow for offline RL that combines critic-based proposal selection with a conditional flow to model multi-modal high-value actions, achieving strong offline and online fine-tuning performance on OGBench.
tldr_zh: PReFlow 提出了一种基于提议条件的细化流，结合评论家提议选择与条件流来建模多模态高价值动作，在 OGBench 上取得了优异的离线和在线微调性能。
summary_zh: 扩散与流策略能够对离线强化学习中的复杂行为进行建模。然而，对其与行为策略之间的KL散度施加惩罚，可能会抑制那些具有高评论家值但行为密度较低的动作。直接优化行为提议或许是一种替代方案，但高斯或确定性编辑器在表达上受限，难以针对同一提议表示多个分离的模态。在本研究中，我们提出提议条件细化流（PReFlow），一种结合基于评论家的提议选择与条件细化流的策略提取方法。为联合优化提议选择与细化过程，我们构建了一个KL正则化目标，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出关于最终动作的吉布斯策略。细化流能够表示多个高值模态，而提议中心的高斯参照则约束大幅动作变化。该高斯参照进一步使我们能够利用无模拟的闭式伴随匹配目标，该目标由采样端点与评论家梯度导出，从而产生单一的速度回归损失，无需反向伴随求解。在50个OGBench任务中，PReFlow取得了具有竞争力的离线性能，并在在线微调后获得所比较方法中的最高总分，在500K环境步后达到91%。

title: Riemannian Splat Regression Models for Learning Time Fields on Arbitrary Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Motion planning on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds is an important and difficult problem that frustrates typical planning methods for Euclidean spaces. In particular, motion planning methods that approximate optimal time-to-go functions with neural networks, e.g., Neural Time Fields (NTFields), cannot be directly applied without using ad-hoc coordinate projections into higher dimensions. Using these methods directly without such projections is desirable, as it promises to provide the lowest-possible-runtime method for obtaining optimal plans on high-dimensional manifolds while using minimal model capacity. In this work, we develop a model that requires no coordinate projection and can learn arbitrary functions on Riemannian manifolds by combining splat regression models with splats defined by wrapped Gaussian distributions. We successfully apply this model for learning arrival time fields on several Riemannian manifolds, and we compare the accuracy and model size of this approach with multi-layer perceptrons adapted to work on each manifold individually.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel Riemannian splat regression model for learning time-to-go functions on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds without coordinate projections, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency over manifold-adapted MLPs for motion planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种黎曼样条回归模型，无需坐标投影即可在任意黎曼流形上学习到达时间函数，并在运动规划中展示了相较于流形自适应MLP的更高精度和效率。
summary_zh: 任意黎曼流形上的运动规划是一个重要且困难的问题，常常令针对欧几里得空间的典型规划方法受挫。特别是，利用神经网络近似最优到达时间函数的运动规划方法（如神经时间场，NTFields）在缺乏针对更高维度的特设坐标投影时，无法直接应用。然而，无需此类投影而直接使用这些方法却极具吸引力，因为这有望提供在保持最小模型容量的同时，于高维流形上获得最优规划的最低运行时方法。在本研究中，我们开发了一种无需坐标投影的模型，通过将样条回归模型与由包裹高斯分布定义的样条相结合，能够在黎曼流形上学习任意函数。我们成功将该模型应用于多个黎曼流形上的到达时间场学习，并将此方法的准确性与模型大小同针对各流形单独调整的多层感知机进行了比较。

title: A robust single-sensing-element tactile sensor for concurrent pressure and tackiness detection with real-time signal decoupling capability
summary: Integrating tackiness sensation into the artificial skin of humanoid robots significantly enhances their cognitive and operational capabilities. However existing tactile sensors face challenges in decoupling of the multimodal signal and stability. Here we present a surface-soft tactile sensor that incorporates a Hall effect sensor and a soft magnetic composite within a robust elastic framework. The sensor surface indents under pressure and bulges prominently when retracted from sticky surfaces dynamically altering the Hall sensor-magnet distance. This generates whole-process-traceable and baseline-separated signals enabling real-time differentiation between pressure and pull-off force. This single-sensing-element design facilitates bimodal sensing at the same contact spot while eliminate stress cross-talk enhancing both accuracy and sensitivity. The fusion of a robust framework and magneto-mechanical sensing mechanism equips the sensor with exceptional reliability and excellent signal baseline stability. This tactile sensor holds substantial potential for advancing robotic capabilities in evaluating adhesive properties monitoring rubber aging precisely handling lightweight objects and cognizing natural objects surface characteristics.
tldr: This paper presents a novel tactile sensor that uses a single Hall effect element and a soft magnetic composite to simultaneously detect pressure and tackiness (pull-off force) with real-time signal decoupling, aimed at enhancing robotic tactile sensing capabilities.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种新型触觉传感器，利用单个霍尔效应元件和软磁复合材料，通过实时信号解耦同时检测压力和粘性（拉力），旨在增强机器人的触觉感知能力。
summary_zh: 将粘性感知整合到仿人机器人的人造皮肤中，显著增强了其认知与操作能力。然而，现有的触觉传感器在多模态信号解耦及稳定性方面面临挑战。本文提出了一种表面柔软型触觉传感器，其将霍尔效应传感器与软磁复合材料集成于坚固的弹性框架内。该传感器表面在受压时内凹，在从粘性表面回撤时则显著隆起，从而动态改变霍尔传感器与磁体之间的距离。这一机制产生了全过程可追踪且基线分离的信号，能够实时区分压力与剥离力。这种单传感元件设计使得在同一接触点实现双模态感知成为可能，同时消除了应力串扰，提升了精度与灵敏度。坚固框架与磁-机械传感机制的融合，赋予了该传感器卓越的可靠性和优异的信号基线稳定性。该触觉传感器在提升机器人评估粘附特性、监测橡胶老化、精确操控轻质物体以及识别自然物体表面特征等能力方面具有巨大潜力。

title: DORA: Divergence-Oriented Data-Relay Algorithm for Partially Connected Robot Teams
summary: Teams of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) deployed for search and monitoring missions frequently operate as partially connected networks, forcing each robot to trade off exploring the environment against relaying information to teammates. This tradeoff is especially acute when robots are semantically heterogeneous: an observation that appears uninformative to the robot that made it may be critical to a teammate with complementary detection capabilities. In this work, we formalize this setting as the heterogeneous mission-aware coverage (HMAC) problem, which couples complete multi-robot coverage of an area with capability-constrained mission-relevant target (MRT) discovery under intermittent communication. We then present DORA, a divergence-oriented data-relay algorithm that drives communication by the value of information to the team rather than by discovery alone. DORA quantifies the mission-relevant divergence between a robot's current information state and its estimate of each teammate's knowledge, capturing mission relevance, discovery novelty, sensor uncertainty, and the age of information. We evaluate DORA in simulation across four environments with differing object densities and spatial structure, and validate it on a physical UAV platform. Our results show that DORA improves MRT resolution delay by up to 74.8% over traditional time-based communication scheduling methods.
tldr: DORA formalizes the heterogeneous mission-aware coverage (HMAC) problem and proposes a divergence-oriented data-relay algorithm for partially connected UAV teams, improving mission-relevant target resolution delay by up to 74.8% over time-based scheduling.
tldr_zh: DORA 形式化了异构任务感知覆盖（HMAC）问题，并提出了一种面向分歧的数据中继算法，用于部分连接的无人机团队，将任务相关目标解决延迟最多降低 74.8%。
summary_zh: 用于搜索与监控任务的无人机集群常常在部分连通网络条件下运行，这迫使每架机器人在探索环境与向队友传递信息之间进行权衡。当机器人具备语义异构性时，这种权衡尤为严峻：一架机器人认为无信息价值的观测结果，可能对具备互补探测能力的队友至关重要。在本研究中，我们将该场景形式化为异构任务感知覆盖（HMAC）问题，该问题将多机器人区域的完全覆盖与间歇通信条件下受能力约束的任务相关目标（MRT）发现相结合。随后，我们提出了DORA——一种面向散度的数据中继算法，该算法以信息对团队的价值驱动通信，而非仅依赖发现结果。DORA量化了机器人当前信息状态与其对每位队友知识估计之间的任务相关散度，综合考虑任务相关性、发现新颖性、传感器不确定性及信息时效。我们在四种具有不同物体密度和空间结构的环境中进行了仿真评估，并在物理无人机平台上进行了验证。结果表明，与传统基于时间的通信调度方法相比，DORA将MRT解析延迟最多降低了74.8%。

title: MagNav: A Dual-Core Magnetic Track Guidance Framework for Lighting-Invariant Navigation in Two-Wheeled Robots
summary: Two-Wheeled Inverted Pendulum (TWIP) robots are useful for studying how to control systems that are naturally unstable and have fewer actuators than degrees of freedom. Adding autonomous line-following to these robots is challenging because steering and balancing are closely linked. Most existing systems use infrared sensors, which can be affected by changes in lighting, such as sunlight or shadows, making them reliable only indoors. This paper presents a self-balancing robot that can follow a line using a magnetic track guidance system. By using a five-channel analog Hall-effect sensor array, the robot is not affected by optical interference. The control system uses a cascaded PID structure: the inner loop keeps the robot balanced using data from an inertial measurement unit with a complementary filter, while the outer loop adjusts steering based on the magnetic sensor readings. Stepper motors provide precise torque control without needing extra rotary encoders. For comparison, an optical sensor module was also included. Tests show that the magnetic guidance system keeps accurate tracking even in very bright lighting, over 10,000 Lux, while the optical system loses accuracy and sometimes fails. This design provides a reliable, lighting-independent solution for autonomous navigation in places like factories, warehouses, and outdoor paths.
tldr: This paper presents a magnetic track guidance system for self-balancing two-wheeled robots, using a Hall-effect sensor array and cascaded PID control to achieve lighting-invariant line-following, outperforming optical sensors in bright conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自平衡两轮机器人的磁轨导引系统，利用霍尔效应传感器阵列和级联PID控制实现不受光照影响的循线导航，在强光条件下优于光学传感器。
